article.articleHeadline: વિશ્વ હિપેટાઈટિસ દિનની ઉજવણી: જામનગરમાં ઇટ્રામાં 150 યુજી-પીજી સ્કોર્લસને હિપેટાઈટિસ બી-સી અંગે વિસ્તૃત માહિતી આપી
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Hepatitis Day celebration: In Jamnagar, 150 UG-PG scholars were given detailed information about Hepatitis B and C in the IT room.
article.articleSummary: World Hepatitis Day was celebrated in Jamnagar by the municipal health department under the theme 'Let's Break It Down' at ITRA, informing approximately 150 undergraduate and postgraduate scholars about Hepatitis B and C in the IT room. Dr. Hareshkumar Gori and city health officer Dr. Palak Ganatra guided the program with support from ITRA's director. Prof. Ami Trivedi, General Medicine and MTC-NVHVP nodal officer, delivered detailed information on Hepatitis B and C—types, symptoms, prevention, vaccination importance, and government-funded free treatment and services. Dean Dr. Nandini Desai attended. IEC materials were displayed to promote awareness in simple language, with Lions Club members also participating. The session noted Hepatitis A and E spread mainly through contaminated water or food, typically causing short-term illness that resolves with proper care. The aim was public awareness, timely diagnosis and treatment, and encouragement of healthy lifestyles.

triage.headline_ja: 世界肝炎デーの祝賀：ジャムナガルのITRAで150名のUG-PG学生に肝炎B・Cについて詳細な情報提供
triage.triage_reason: 世界肝炎デーの啓発イベントに関する報道であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾病発生報告ではなく、世界肝炎デーに合わせた啓発・教育活動の紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: 新冠卷土重来 大陆医生：急诊室都挤爆了
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 resurges; doctors in Mainland China: Emergency rooms are packed.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurges in Mainland China as SARS-CoV-2 positivity climbs above 20% in national sentinel acute respiratory disease surveillance for July 20–26, with the NB.1.8.1 lineage remaining the dominant strain. Among influenza-like illness samples, COVID-19 positivity is 20.3% and influenza 14.5%; infection positivity is highest in ages 0–4, 15–59, and 60+. Over three weeks, emergency department COVID-19 positivity nearly doubled from 9.6% to 20.3%. Official data may undercount due to opacity. Reports from Liaoning indicate concentrated outbreaks with rising antiviral use; social media from Shanghai, Hangzhou, Shanxi, Beijing describe renewed infections and household spread. A July 29 Zhengzhou case, a 36-year-old man, began with cold symptoms and developed fulminant myocarditis, surviving after 20 days in intensive care. By late July, doctors in Shandong and elsewhere reported crowded ERs and bed shortages.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナが再流行、中国本土の医師：救急外来はパンク状態
triage.triage_reason: 中国本土でCOVID-19陽性率が急上昇し救急外来が逼迫、重症例（劇症型心筋炎）も報告されており、WPRO基準の複数該当とSNS上の社会的関心の高まりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: 公式統計の不透明性が指摘されており、実際の感染規模は過小評価の可能性がある。NB.1.8.1系統が優勢株として継続。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le nombre de contacts non vus a doublé en onze jours, de 1 988 à 4 408
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the number of unseen contacts has doubled in eleven days, from 1,988 to 4,408.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a widening gap in follow-up despite ongoing transmission. By 30 July 2026, 17,863 contacts are under follow-up with 13,455 seen, leaving 4,408 not seen—a floor estimate based on zones reporting data; stock rose from 10,519 on 19 July. Across 49 of 140 affected health zones, Ituri accounts for 11,638 contacts (8,781 seen, 75.5%), and Nord-Kivu about 5,700 (roughly 74.7% seen); Haut-Uélé 458 (80.6%), Tshopo 66.2% (43/65); Kabondo Kisangani 0%; Sud-Kivu follow-up closed. In Ituri, Mahagi, Kambala and Boga report 0%; Nyankunde 12.7%, Bunia 22% data reported. Since the outbreak began on 15 May 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases have been recorded. The COUSP notes weak, declining follow-up, risking uninterrupted transmission, with calls to strengthen RECO community relays, supervision, and investigate the follow-up drop.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：追跡できていない接触者数が11日間で1,988人から4,408人へと倍増
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的な人-人感染が確認され、接触者追跡の著しい遅延・欠落（追跡率低下）が国際的拡大リスクを高めており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の多くに該当する。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにイタリア（Lombardia）が含まれているが、記事内容はDRC国内の流行に関するものであり、イタリアでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。2026年5月15日発生以降、3,605例の確定症例が報告されており、接触者追跡率の低下（特にKabondo Kisangani 0%、Sud-Kivuでは追跡終了）が感染拡大継続のリスクとして強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ausbruch des Bundibugyo-Virus eskaliert in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Bundibugyo virus outbreak escalates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus outbreak escalates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 30 July 2026, the World Health Organization reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths. Transmission continues, with rising case counts and fatalities and expanding geographic spread, signaling a growing health emergency. In the past week, 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly totals since the outbreak began, indicating an unprecedented speed of spread. Factors impeding response include insecurity, population displacement, and cross-border movement. National authorities, WHO and partners are implementing extensive outbreak-control measures, but there is a need to scale up activities across sectors to curb transmission. Bundibugyo virus is a type of Ebola virus that causes Bundibugyo virus disease, a viral hemorrhagic illness.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:ブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ）の流行がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ(ブンディブギョウ型)の症例・死亡者数が急増し、地理的拡大と国境を越えた移動により国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約44%と極めて高く、週間症例数・死亡数が過去最高を記録。治安不安や住民移動が対応を阻害しており、国際支援の必要性が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Latest WHO Updates on Ebola in DRC Shows 3605 Infections, 1587 Deaths and Fatality Ratio Reaching 44 Percent
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 3,605 infections and 1,587 deaths as of 30 July 2026, a 44% case fatality ratio. It is the country’s largest Ebola outbreak, expanding from Mongbwalu in Ituri Province to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. Ituri accounts for 88% of cases and 82.6% of deaths. In epidemiological week 30, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported, driven largely by transmission, despite some increases from enhanced surveillance. So far, 17,863 contacts are being monitored; 151 healthcare workers have been infected with 44 deaths. Insecurity, attacks on facilities, displacement and cross-border movement hinder control. Uganda has declared its outbreak over (28 July) but remains at risk for imports. WHO calls for major scale-up in surveillance, testing, care, IPC, contact tracing, logistics and community engagement ahead of the 18 August IHR Emergency Committee meeting.

triage.headline_ja: WHOの最新情報によるとDRCのエボラ出血熱は感染者3605人、死者1587人、致死率44%に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率44%、49保健地域に拡大、国際越境リスクもあり8月18日にIHR緊急委員会開催予定であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダはアウトブレイク終息宣言済み（7月28日）だが越境リスクが残るとされている。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。8月18日のIHR緊急委員会の結果により渡航貿易制限の可能性あり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: India approves QDENGA dengue vaccine; rollout still months away
article.articleSummary: India approves manufacture of QDENGA dengue vaccine, the world's first widely approved dengue vaccine, offering prevention to crores of people in India where dengue resurges each monsoon. The Drug Controller General of India has cleared production of QDENGA, signaling a shift after decades dominated by mosquito control, public awareness campaigns, and supportive treatment. The vaccine’s introduction promises prevention rather than cure and could become a key tool against one of India's fastest-growing seasonal health threats. Rollout remains months away, with supply and distribution likely to shape the timetable. This development highlights the seasonality of dengue in India and the potential to reduce the annual disease burden once manufacturing and deployment scale up across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: インド、デング熱ワクチンQDENGAを承認 ― 実際の提供開始はまだ数ヶ月先
triage.triage_reason: ワクチン承認に関する政策・製薬ニュースであり、新規の異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節的流行に対するワクチン承認のニュースであり、疾病発生イベントそのものではないためDISMISS。ただし公衆衛生政策として社会的関心はある。

article.articleHeadline: Baguio records increase in acute gastroenteritis, rotavirus and typhoid cases
article.articleSummary: Baguio City records rising acute gastroenteritis in 2026, with rotavirus and typhoid fever driving most food- and waterborne illness, per PIDRU surveillance. Local communities reported 163 cases; hospital reports under validation total 332. From January–July 2026, acute bloody diarrhea reached 42 cases (up from 26 in 2025); June–July 2026 saw 15 cases vs 9 in 2025. Cholera added 2 cases in June–July 2026 (vs 1), with cumulative five cases in both years. Rotavirus rose to 84 cases June–July (vs 62), cumulative 331 in 2026 vs 160 in 2025 (+107%). Typhoid fever reached 52 cases (vs 35); cumulative 125 vs 73 (+71%). No deaths reported for any of the four diseases. CHSO and sanitation division monitor water quality; issues addressed. Boil drinking water for at least three minutes if safety is uncertain; practice handwashing and safe food handling; seek medical care for diarrhea, vomiting, or abdominal pain.

triage.headline_ja: バギオ市で急性胃腸炎、ロタウイルス、腸チフスの症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン・バギオ市でロタウイルスや腸チフスなど水系・食品由来感染症が前年比で大幅増加しているが、死亡例はなく地域レベルの公衆衛生問題にとどまるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 死亡例なし、地域保健当局(CHSO)が水質監視と衛生対策を実施中。前年比での症例増加率は高いが、季節的な食品・水系感染症の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자, 3500명 돌파... 역대 두 번째 규모 확산
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpass 3,500... the second-largest outbreak on record.
article.articleSummary: On July 31, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak surpassed 3,500 cases and 1,500 deaths, with official counts at 3,532 cases and 1,556 deaths. The eastern DRC outbreak is the second-largest on record after the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone: 28,616 cases, 11,310 deaths). Experts warn the true scale could be up to four times higher; there are no approved treatments or vaccines for this Bundibugyo strain, and WHO says months are needed to deliver therapeutics. Security challenges from armed groups and reduced international aid complicate response. The Africa CDC has cited a $1.4 billion funding need for June–August, but Congo’s response plan has secured only about $213.9 million.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確定患者、3500人突破…史上2番目の規模の拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが3500例・1500人超の死者を記録し、史上2番目の規模かつ承認された治療薬・ワクチンがない深刻な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: 西アフリカ（ギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ）は2014-2016年の過去の流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。承認された治療薬・ワクチンの不在、資金不足（$1.4B必要に対し$213.9Mのみ確保）、武装勢力による治安上の課題も深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 苏暁康|瘟弹：热核等级
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Su Xiaokang | Plague Bomb: Thermonuclear Grade
article.articleSummary: A provocative piece juxtaposes Nazi genocide with modern incineration claims in Wuhan, questioning whether toxic-killing and burning differ in essence. Auschwitz is cited as having killed about 6,000 people in a single day. It then asserts Wuhan shipped 40 mobile medical waste incinerators, each allegedly able to burn 30 corpses per day (1,200 per day total), with rumors of a million units capable of burning 30 million corpses daily. The author muses whether virus-driven deaths followed by cremation resemble earlier mass murder. A note references Fauci’s July 29 testimony on COVID-19 origins and U.S. pandemic response, stating he denied funding the Wuhan Institute of Virology. The piece also includes an extended Henry Kissinger interview on US–China competition, Taiwan, and strategic shifts, framing these issues within a broader geopolitical contest.

triage.headline_ja: 蘇曉康｜瘟弾：熱核等級
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はナチスの大量虐殺と武漢での火葬・遺体焼却に関する陰謀論的な政治評論であり、現在進行中の感染症発生に関する情報を含まない。COVID-19起源やファウチ証言、キッシンジャー氏の地政学的見解に関する言論記事であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2020年武漢での火葬に関する陰謀論的な歴史的言及と、COVID-19起源をめぐる政治的論説（ファウチ証言、キッシンジャー氏の米中関係論）であり、現在発生している感染症イベントの報告ではない。感染症サーベイランスの対象としての新規性・緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 陸派出第三批醫療專家赴剛果　協助防控伊波拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China dispatches the third batch of medical experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to assist in the prevention and control of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Third batch of Ebola-response medical experts from Mainland China arrived in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on August 1 to assist local outbreak control. A representative of the DRC Ministry of Health welcomed the group, noting the Ebola situation remains severe with ongoing pressure on surveillance, patient care, and laboratory testing. Team leader Yang Xiaocheng said the group will build on previous missions, tailoring technical support to needs and deepening collaboration with DRC health authorities and international partners to accelerate outbreak containment. The delegation includes professionals from the National Health Commission, General Administration of Customs, Zhejiang University School of Medicine's First Affiliated Hospital, and the Chinese CDC, with expertise in epidemiology, health quarantine, clinical management, and pathogen laboratory diagnostics. No specific case counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 中国本土、コンゴ民主共和国へ第3陣の医療専門家を派遣　エボラ出血熱の防疫を支援
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が依然深刻で、国際支援（中国からの専門家派遣）が継続的に必要とされており、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事は中国からの医療支援チーム派遣に焦点を当てており、具体的な症例数の記載はない。中国（浙江省含む）は支援派遣元であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'Africa CDC alerte sur la propagation du virus la plus rapide jamais enregistrée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Africa CDC warns of the fastest spread of the virus ever recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) shows the fastest spread on record, according to Africa CDC. As of the latest figures, 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported. In the week of July 21–27, 2026, 488 deaths were recorded, marking an increase of about 50%. Transmission has accelerated, with Budinbugyo strain positive tests rising from 37.8% to 46.9% in one month. A first candidate vaccine, ChaDoX1, is in trials. Africa CDC notes the contact list in the DRC should exceed 130,000 people, yet only about 13,000 are being followed. More than 80% of new infections are not linked to known cases, complicating tracing. On the ground, roughly 80% of hospital beds are occupied, with North Kivu centers experiencing severe overcrowding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱DRC:アフリカCDCが過去最速のウイルス拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の症例・死亡者数が急増し、追跡不能な感染連鎖が80%を超え、医療体制も逼迫しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが過去最速の感染拡大と警告しており、接触者追跡率が低い(約10%)ことや新規感染の80%以上が既知の感染連鎖と無関係である点が特に懸念される。ワクチン治験が進行中だが、現時点で普及には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, says WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus strain, is the largest on record with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (44% CFR) as of 30 July 2026. Declared on 15 May 2026, it surpasses the 2018–2020 outbreak (about 3,500 cases and around 2,300 deaths). There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyro, though vaccines are in development in the UK and Singapore, with the most promising candidate to be developed in Singapore and a trial underway in the UK. The WHO says the outbreak is intensifying, with the past week bringing 567 cases and 296 deaths. Transmission is through contact with bodily fluids. The epicenter is Ituri province in northeast DRC, bordering South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to North and South Kivu. Insecurity, displacement, and cross-border movement hinder response; Uganda has 20 cases, France one case, and two DR Congo cases were treated in Germany.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行はDRCで史上最悪とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行（3,605症例、致死率44%）で複数国への越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため直ちにフルリスク評価に進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しないBundibugyo株による流行で、致死率44%と極めて高い。ウガンダ、フランス、ドイツへの症例流出が確認されており国際的拡大が現実化している。治安不安・住民避難・越境移動が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: DBD pada Anak: Jangan Terlena Saat Demam Mulai Turun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in children: Don't let your guard down when the fever starts to subside.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's dengue fever in children: Medical expert warns that the period after fever subsides can be critical; parents should monitor for persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, nosebleeds or bleeding gums, extreme lethargy, restlessness, or decreased consciousness and seek care promptly to prevent complications. Dengue is not seasonal; transmission risk persists year-round in Indonesia; during the dry season, standing water in containers continues to breed Aedes mosquitoes if not cleaned or emptied. With the new school year starting, children returning to school remain at risk without consistent prevention. Ministry of Health data from 2018 to 2025 show the 5-14 age group accounts for the highest dengue mortality; in 2025 about 59 percent of dengue deaths occurred in ages 0-14, with 41 percent in 5-14.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のデング熱：解熱し始めた時こそ油断禁物
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する一般的な健康啓発・注意喚起記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の年間を通じた流行性・小児死亡率に関する啓発記事。新規の異常な増加や集団発生の報告はなく、既知の季節・地域リスクに関する一般的な医療情報提供が主旨。

article.articleHeadline: La paradoja del nuevo brote de ébola: fracaso sanitario y avances científicos en tiempo récord
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The paradox of the new Ebola outbreak: healthcare system failure and scientific advances in record time.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), in Ituri province, northeast, remains out of control two months after detection. On 30 July 2026, government data show 3,442 confirmed cases and 1,521 deaths, making it the third-largest Ebola outbreak on record. The virus appears to have circulated for months before detection, with transmission chains across war-torn Ituri amid poor health infrastructure, population movement, and distrust of authorities, producing hidden chains and high community deaths. A cross-border corridor with South Sudan and Uganda facilitates spread. Bundibugyo tends to cause somewhat milder illness, paradoxically enabling broader transmission as patients delay seeking care. The outbreak highlights systemic health and humanitarian failures, despite accelerated vaccine and antiviral research. In weeks, preventive and therapeutic trials were launched, including obeldesivir, an oral antiviral from Gilead, and a phase 1 Oxford vaccine trial. A preventive study started July 14 for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ新規流行のパラドックス:医療体制の失敗と記録的速さの科学的進歩
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で確認3,442例・死亡1,521例に達する史上第3位規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が制御不能で、南スーダン・ウガンダとの越境回廊を通じた国際拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ・南スーダンを越境拡大の経路として言及しているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento nas infecções por HIV no Brasil exige mais das autoridades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in HIV Infections in Brazil Demands More from the Authorities.
article.articleSummary: HIV infections in Brazil rose 21.9% from 2010 to 2024, against a global 43% drop in new infections and a worldwide HIV population of about 41 million, including 1.7 million in Brazil. UNAIDS cautions the world will miss the 2030 target to reduce new infections and AIDS deaths by 90%; annual deaths declined 57% to roughly 570,000, still 400,000 above the target. Scientific tools—safe-sex campaigns, antiretroviral therapy (ART), and pre/post-exposure prophylaxis—exist, but sustained public policies are essential. Brazil, once a regional exemplar for HIV response, now ranks among countries with rising infections. Globally, mother-to-child transmission prevention reached 87% in 2025 (vs. 24% a decade-and-a-half earlier), ART coverage reached 78% (vs. 24% then). Brazil’s 95-95-95 indicators are 96-82-95. Gaps in treatment initiation, monitoring, and continuity demand active case finding and uninterrupted drug supply within the SUS framework.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおけるHIV感染増加、当局のさらなる対応が必要
triage.triage_reason: HIV感染率上昇は長期的な公衆衛生政策課題を論じた社説であり、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常事象ではないため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: HIVは慢性感染症であり、本記事は2010-2024年の長期トレンドに関する社説・政策論評。急性アウトブレイクの兆候はなく、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の内容と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: l'Africa CDC alerte sur la propagation du virus la plus rapide jamais enregistrée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Africa CDC warns of the fastest spread of the virus ever recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 August 2026, Africa CDC warns Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading at its fastest rate on record. The DRC reports 3,605 detected cases and 1,587 deaths, including 488 deaths in the week of 21–27 July, a near 50% increase. Uganda declared the outbreak over on 28 July. A candidate vaccine, ChaDoX1, is in trials. Budinbugyo-strain positive test rates rose from 37.8% to 46.9% in one month, complicating case tracking. Africa CDC estimates the contact-casing list should exceed 130,000 individuals, but only about 13,000 are currently under follow-up. Hospital capacity is strained, with 80% of beds occupied on average and surges in North Kivu. About 80% of new infections are not linked to known cases, indicating widespread community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国）：アフリカCDCが観測史上最速の感染拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が観測史上最速のペースで拡大しており、感染者数・死亡者数が急増し地域社会での広範な伝播が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダは7月28日にアウトブレイク終息を宣言済みのため、記事の主題は主にDRCでの継続的な感染拡大。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。接触者追跡が130,000人規模と推定されるのに対し実際の追跡は約13,000人にとどまり、病床占有率も高く、コミュニティ内感染（新規感染の約80%が既知症例と無関係）が進行している点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Trả giá đắt vì nhiễm virus viêm gan B 20 năm không điều trị, còn lây nhiễm sang cả nhà
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paying a heavy price for 20 years of untreated hepatitis B infection, and spreading it to the entire family.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis B virus infection can silently persist in the liver for decades, eventually causing cirrhosis, liver failure, and cancer if untreated. At Bach Mai Hospital in Hanoi, a 53-year-old man diagnosed 20 years ago stopped antiviral therapy after feeling better; two decades later he has cirrhosis, ascites, esophageal varices, peritoneal infection, and requires dialysis. His wife and children were later found infected, underscoring family transmission. In Nam Dinh Province, two brothers infected by their mother illustrate divergent outcomes: the elder adheres to treatment and vaccination, staying well and preventing spread; the younger, diagnosed at 45, has transmitted to his wife and son. Experts urge regular HBV DNA testing, liver fibrosis assessment, and continued antiviral therapy; vaccinating and screening household contacts, and preventing mother-to-child transmission via prenatal management and timely neonatal vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 20年間治療しなかったB型肝炎ウイルス感染で高い代償、家族全員に感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: 個人の慢性B型肝炎に関する健康啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 既知の慢性感染症（B型肝炎）に関する個人症例・啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや新規発生事象ではないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: خارج السيطرة.. "إيبولا" يلتهم الكونغو !
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Out of control... Ebola ravages the Congo!
article.articleSummary: As of August 2, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, with the World Health Organization calling the outbreak the largest and most severe in the country’s history. The situation risks cross-border transmission to neighboring nations as the outbreak escalates. In the past week, 567 new cases were reported and 296 deaths occurred, the highest weekly toll yet. Cumulatively, there are 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, with 651 recoveries. The surge is partly attributed to expanded surveillance and intensified laboratory testing that reveal previously undetected cases. The WHO urges a rapid, comprehensive scale-up of field response measures to curb transmission and prevent further regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: 制御不能...「エボラ」がコンゴを食い尽くす！
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ史上最大・最重症のエボラ流行と表明し、国境を越えた拡大リスクがあるため、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（1587/3605）、週間新規症例・死亡数ともに過去最多。WHOが大規模な対応拡大を要請しており、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫：本轮疫情为刚果（金）史上最大埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: This round of the outbreak is the largest Ebola outbreak in the history of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest on record, with 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths reported as of July 31. The epidemic, concentrated in Ituri Province and expanding to five provinces across 49 health zones, continues to intensify. The WHO classifies domestic outbreak risk as 'very high.' The DRC government, WHO, and partners are accelerating surveillance, patient care, and contact tracing, but response efforts remain severely challenged by armed conflict, displacement, and limited healthcare infrastructure. Currently, 760 patients are in isolation or hospital, with 666 survivors. There is no approved vaccine or specific therapy for the circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; multiple candidate vaccines and treatments have begun laboratory or field trials. No information on imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:今回の流行はコンゴ民主共和国史上最大のエボラ出血熱の流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行が発生し、致死率が高く、WHOが国内リスクを「非常に高い」と分類、承認済みワクチン・治療薬もなく武力紛争により対応が困難であるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模の流行であり、5州49保健区域に拡大、致死率約44%（1621/3674）と高い。ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・治療法がなく、武力紛争や住民の避難により対応が困難な状況。フルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 爱涮火锅的重庆人，当心戊肝找上门！重庆感染科专家刘敏：可防可治
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chongqing Hot Pot Lovers, Beware Hepatitis E Knocking at Your Door! Chongqing Infectious Disease Expert Liu Min: Preventable and Curable.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis E (HEV) outbreak in Chongqing, China. The Chongqing Health Commission reports rising HEV activity in 2026: 95 cases in February, and 99 cases in May–June. Pork-associated sources are key—undercooked pig liver and kidneys, pork products, shellfish, plus contaminated water and shared prep surfaces; hotpot dining heightens exposure. HEV incubation is 2–10 weeks. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea; later dark urine and jaundice. Most adults recover with supportive care, but infection in late pregnancy carries 20–25% mortality, and elderly (over 45–60) and chronic liver disease increase risk (about 17.7% mortality with chronic liver disease). Immunocompromised individuals can become chronically infected. No specific antiviral exists; severe cases may require liver support. China-developed YikeNing (益可宁) vaccine—0,1,6 months—promises 100% efficacy during the full course and 86.6% after 10 years; recommended for pregnant women preconception, elderly, chronic liver disease patients, high‑risk workers, and travelers. Anti-HEV IgG testing guides immunity; vaccination status reviewed at Chongqing Public Health Center.

triage.headline_ja: 火鍋好きの重慶市民は要注意、E型肝炎が忍び寄る！重慶感染症専門家・劉敏氏：予防・治療可能
triage.triage_reason: E型肝炎は中国で既知の風土病であり、豚肉・鍋料理関連の感染経路も既知。ワクチンも存在し予防・治療可能な疾患で、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は重慶市の公衆衛生啓発・健康教育目的の内容であり、E型肝炎の症例数増加(2月95例、5-6月99例)は報告されているが、既知の食品由来感染症であり、ワクチンも存在するため緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 中国冠病阳性率突破20% 中疾控强调属周期性波动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 positivity rate surpasses 20%; China CDC emphasizes that it is a cyclical fluctuation.
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 positivity rate in the 30th week of 2026 rose above 20% to 20.3% of respiratory samples collected in sentinel hospitals from July 20–26, with influenza at 14.5%. The NB.1.8.1 lineage remains predominant; southern provinces show higher positivity than northern regions, and 15–59-year-olds have the highest rate. The China CDC states the rebound is a regular cyclical fluctuation since COVID-19 management shifted to Category B; the current wave’s strength is comparable to the past two years and has not disrupted overall healthcare. Most cases remain mild, but the elderly and those with chronic diseases remain at high risk of severe disease. Existing targeted antivirals remain effective; no evidence of a variant causing a significant public health risk is detected.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の新型コロナ陽性率が20%を突破、中国疾病予防管理センターは周期的な変動と強調
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCが例年通りの周期的変動と説明しており、重症例の急増や医療逼迫、新規変異株のリスクも確認されていないため、通常のサーベイランス情報として扱う。
triage.notes: 中国CDCは例年と同程度の季節的再流行と説明し、既存の抗ウイルス薬が有効であること、重大な公衆衛生リスクをもたらす変異株の証拠がないことを明言している。高齢者・基礎疾患患者は重症化リスクありとされるが、全体の医療体制への影響はないとされている。

article.articleHeadline: วิกฤตอีโบลาคองโกระบาดรุนแรงสุดในประวัติศาสตร์ ดับแล้ว 1,587 ราย WHO เตือนความเสี่ยงสูงมาก : อินโฟเควสท์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo Ebola outbreak—the deadliest in history; 1,587 deaths; WHO warns of very high risk: InfoQuest.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ebola outbreak—the largest on record—has 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality 44%) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, per WHO as of Aug 1, 2026. Spread covers 49 health zones across five provinces, with a rising impact on healthcare systems (151 health workers infected, 44 deaths). Ongoing conflict, population displacement, high mobility, and cross-border movement complicate surveillance, case finding, and access to care; attacks on health facilities further hinder response. WHO assigns domestic risk as 'very high' and calls for urgent expansion of proactive measures: enhanced surveillance and screening, laboratory capacity, clinical care and infection prevention and control, community engagement, and robust logistics to curb transmission and coordinate outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機、史上最悪の流行に―死者1,587人、WHOが極めて高いリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 史上最大規模のエボラ流行で致死率44%、WHOが国内リスクを「非常に高い」と評価しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 紛争・住民移動・越境移動により監視・対応が困難化しており、WHOは積極的サーベイランス拡大等の緊急対応を要請している。国際的拡大リスクは越境移動の言及から示唆されるが、具体的な他国への感染確認は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: How Virunga Park protects people and gorillas from Ebola in eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks continue in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, with the World Health Organization declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. Virunga National Park, Africa’s oldest, is expanding health measures to protect communities and mountain gorillas within a 300‑km protected corridor. The 2018–2020 outbreak killed nearly 2,300 people; the current outbreak has killed more than 1,400, according to Congolese health authorities. Six health checkpoints along the park’s territory, plus roadblocks with handwashing, temperature screening, and first‑level isolation centres, form part of a six‑month emergency response backed by 40 paramedics and 80 rangers. In Ituri around Bunia, three checkpoints screen travellers; two suspected cases were identified and referred to public health authorities. Gorillas remain highly vulnerable due to over 90% DNA overlap with humans, underscoring a One Health approach and data sharing with the National Institute of Public Health.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィルンガ国立公園、コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラからゴリラと住民を守る取り組み
triage.triage_reason: WHOが5月にPHEICを宣言したコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行が継続し、死者数が1,400人を超え、隣国ウガンダにも波及している重大な公衆衛生事案であるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。WHOは既に2026年5月にPHEICを宣言済みであり、既存の国際緊急事態として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو يخرج عن السيطرة وخطر انتقاله يتصاعد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo spiraling out of control and the risk of its transmission rising.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spiraling out of control and cross-border transmission risk is rising. The current outbreak is the largest in the country’s history, with 567 new infections and 296 deaths in the past week—the highest weekly total since the outbreak began. Cumulative confirmed cases reach 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. The rise in cases reflects broader virus spread and improved surveillance and testing, yet response teams can trace only about 80% of contacts, insufficient to halt transmission. Control efforts are hampered by security and humanitarian challenges, including armed conflict, displacement, and limited access to treatment centers, suggesting the true case count may be higher than reported.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴのエボラ流行が制御不能に陥り、感染拡大リスクが高まっている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ史上最大のエボラ流行が制御不能と警告し、致死率・感染者数が急増、越境拡大リスクも指摘されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: WHOによる公式警告であり、死亡者数・感染者数の急増、接触者追跡率が80%に留まる点、治安・人道危機による対応困難さが強調されている。越境感染リスクへの言及もあり緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：本轮疫情为刚果（金）史上最大埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: This Ebola outbreak is the largest in the history of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of July 31, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 3,674 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 1,621 deaths. The World Health Organization on August 1 said this outbreak is the largest Ebola outbreak on record in DRC. The epidemic has spread beyond Ituri Province’s Mombalu Health Zone to 49 health zones across five provinces. Ongoing conflict, population displacement, and limited health infrastructure heighten transmission risk. The WHO classifies the domestic outbreak risk as 'very high.' The DRC government, with WHO and partners, continues surveillance, patient care, and contact tracing, but response efforts require substantial strengthening. Currently, 760 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, with 666 recovered. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy; several candidate vaccines and drugs are in early trials.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:今回の流行はコンゴ民主共和国史上最大のエボラ流行
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大規模のエボラ流行であり、致死率が高く5州49保健区に拡大、WHOが国内リスクを『非常に高い』と評価しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 致死率は約44%（1,621/3,674）と非常に高く、紛争・人口移動・限られた医療インフラが感染拡大リスクを高めている。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のBundibugyoエボラウイルスが原因。WHOは国内リスクを『非常に高い』と評価。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo | L'Ebola poursuit ses ravages
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Ebola continues to ravage
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding at an unprecedented pace. Since May 15, authorities report more than 3,600 cases and 1,556 deaths from the Bundibugyo strain, with total fatalities from 2018–2020 around 2,300. WHO cautions true case counts may be 2–4 times higher. About 90% of cases are in Ituri, with spread to South Kivu, North Kivu, and recently Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Contributing factors include armed conflict causing displacement, distrust of authorities, and misinformation; burials and contact tracing face cultural and security obstacles. Healthcare workers have been targeted; late presentations to treatment centers have occurred. The outbreak overlaps with malaria season, risking added pressure on an already strained system. International funding gaps and travel bans complicate response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 | エボラの猛威が続く
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで前例のない速度で拡大し、3,600例超・1,556人死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限も既に発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 武力紛争・不信感・誤情報が対応を阻害しており、マラリア流行期との重複で医療体制への負荷増大が懸念される。国際的な資金不足と渡航制限も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, il virus si può fermare: la lezione dell'Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the virus can be stopped: Uganda's lesson.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo virus erupted in Uganda in 2026, linked to imported cases from DRC. Uganda recorded 20 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; the DRC outbreak expanded to thousands of infections and deaths. Of Ugandan cases, 15 were imported from DRC and 5 occurred among contacts and health workers. Transmission chain in Uganda was broken; last patient was discharged on 16 July, launching a 42-day surveillance countdown, though 28 July saw no official declaration of end. Lessons: readiness before alarms, since Bundibugyo virus has no licensed vaccines or specific treatments; containment hinges on rapid diagnosis, isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention, safe burials, and community cooperation. Uganda used 21-day contact monitoring, stronger surveillance at risk districts and entry points, and dedicated transport. Cross-border cooperation with DRC—joint tracing, shared labs, and entry procedures—requires trust and local engagement; by late July 2026, DRC faced sustained transmission with increased mortality.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ウイルスは食い止められる：ウガンダの教訓
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダに越境し、DRCでは数千人規模の感染・死亡が継続しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでの封じ込め成功事例を主題としているが、DRCでは依然として持続的な感染拡大と死亡率上昇が報告されており、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に採用。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Resmen belge yayınladılar: 'Kovid-19 Laboratuvardan Sızdı!'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They officially released a document: 'COVID-19 leaked from the laboratory!'
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-02, a White House document released on its official website and on X asserts that COVID-19 did not emerge naturally from bats or wildlife markets. The report contends the virus possessed biological features not found in nature and leaked from the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China after unsafe gain-of-function experiments. It argues that lax biosafety at the Wuhan institute contributed to the outbreak, framing the global crisis as the result of a laboratory incident. The release treats longstanding claims of a laboratory origin as supported by official documentation, reviving debates once dismissed as conspiracy theories and censored on social media. The article centers on origin and laboratory safety rather than clinical details.

triage.headline_ja: 公式文書を発表：『COVID-19は研究所から流出した！』
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規感染症の発生や症例急増を報じるものではなく、COVID-19起源に関する政治的・歴史的な文書公開についての報道であり、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19の起源（実験室流出説）に関する米ホワイトハウス文書公開についての政治的議論であり、現在進行中の感染症発生事象ではないため対象国に該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: 7000 ಕಾಲೇಜು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ HIV- ವರದಿ ಸುಳ್ಳು: ನ್ಯಾಕೋ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಒಪ್ಪಲ್ಲ; ರಾಜ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೋಂಕು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿದೆ; ಯು.ಟಿ. ಖಾದರ್‌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: False HIV report for 7,000 college students: NACO does not accept the information; infection is under control in the state; U. T. Khader.
article.articleSummary: HIV misinformation in Karnataka was rejected by NACO; Health Minister U. T. Khader stated in Bengaluru that NACO’s figure of 56,000 cases is not accepted, clarifying that a false report suggested about 7,000 college students were HIV positive. The health department is prepared to issue a clarification. Since 2004, Karnataka has recorded 39,028 HIV infections; 18–35-year-olds are receiving treatment. HIV testing is conducted in only two settings: during pregnancy and when blood is donated. Officials say the state’s HIV situation is under control. In the last three months, 3,091 infections were detected among 553,453 people tested, and 281,742 pregnant women were tested for HIV in the same period, indicating ongoing surveillance and targeted testing in Karnataka.

triage.headline_ja: 7000人の大学生がHIV感染という報道は虚偽:NACO情報を否定;州内の感染は管理下にある;U.T.カダール氏
triage.triage_reason: 誤情報を否定する内容であり、当局は感染状況を管理下にあると説明している。新規の異常な公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV感染拡大に関する誤情報（7000人感染）を当局が否定する内容。既知の風土病であるHIVの通常の監視活動報告であり、EBSシグナルとしての新規性・異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة دولية : الأبيض على شفا كارثة إنسانية مع نقص المياه وتفشي الكوليرا - اخبار السودان
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An International Organization: Al-Ubayyid on the Brink of a Humanitarian Catastrophe Amid Water Shortages and a Cholera Outbreak - Sudan News
article.articleSummary: Al-Ubayyid, in North Kordofan, Sudan, is on the brink of a humanitarian catastrophe due to a cholera outbreak, severe water shortages, and food insecurity. Plan International reports a 70% water-supply gap as main sources are out of service amid siege and Rapid Support Forces attacks, with displacement swelling the population. The city hosts about 105,000 internally displaced people in camps and shelters; health centers and sanitation infrastructure are heavily damaged, compounded by rainfall and poor hygiene in camps. Recently, the army recaptured Barra and Jabra al-Sheikh and other sites along the export road to deter a RSF ground assault, but the area remains under drone strikes. Plan International calls for urgent international action to protect children, warning of malnutrition, gender-based violence at water points, and risk of child recruitment. The NGO continues life-saving aid despite power, water, and food disruptions and restricted access.

triage.headline_ja: 国際機関:アル・アビイドは水不足とコレラ流行により人道的破局の瀬戸際に - スーダンニュース
triage.triage_reason: スーダン(北コルドファン州)におけるコレラ流行と人道危機に関する記事であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないためDISMISSとする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazil(Bahia, Barra)が含まれるが、記事本文はスーダンのコレラ流行に関する内容であり、Brazilは無関係。対象国リストにSudanは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo: el brote agrava el hambre y ya dejó casi 1.500 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo: the outbreak worsens hunger and has already claimed nearly 1,500 lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 3,360 confirmed cases and 1,487 deaths as of May 15, 2026, with Ituri as the epicenter amid ongoing violence and displacement. The Bundibugyo variant has no vaccines or approved treatments; a vaccine trial is underway but not yet available in the country. The UN warns that containment measures are disrupting markets and supply routes, deepening hunger in a region where about 10 million people face crisis or emergency food insecurity, including ~1.9 million in Ituri needing food assistance. The World Food Programme has cut aid from around 3 million people last year to about 1 million this year due to funding gaps, distributing over 160,000 hot meals in 17 treatment centers. Forty-eight health zones are directly affected, and insecurity further hampers farming.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱：流行が飢餓を悪化させ、既に死者数は約1,500人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo変異株）の大規模流行で確定症例3,360件、死者1,487人に達しており、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認かつ紛争・食料危機と絡み合い公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクがあるため。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認で有効な治療法が限定的な状況に加え、紛争・避難民・食料危機が重なり封じ込めが困難な状況。WFPの支援縮小によりさらなる悪化が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: U ženy po návratu z Ugandy je podezření na nebezpečnou nákazu, je na Bulovce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A woman who has returned from Uganda is suspected of a dangerous infection, and she is at Bulovka Hospital.
article.articleSummary: A woman returning from Uganda was admitted to Bulovka Hospital in Prague with a suspected highly dangerous infection. She was transported from University Hospital Hradec Králové and is being tested for Ebola, Marburg, dengue, or other tropical viral hemorrhagic fevers. Health authorities say the probability of infection is very low and there is no public risk. Public health officials are coordinating with emergency services; a danger zone around the clinic was established, and the ambulance, staff, and responders were decontaminated. Uganda recently reported an Ebola outbreak had ended after 42 days since the last case, with 20 infections and 2 deaths; most cases occurred in neighboring Congo, which has reported over 3,500 cases and about 1,556 deaths. An American physician previously at Bulovka was isolated as a precaution in late May/June but did not become ill.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダから帰国した女性、危険な感染症の疑いでブルカ病院に搬送
triage.triage_reason: 疑い例はチェコで発生しており、対象国（DRC等）は過去のウガンダ流行の背景情報として言及されているに過ぎず、記事の主題ではない。当局も感染確率は非常に低いと発表している。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はチェコ国内での疑い症例（検査中、未確定）であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCは過去のウガンダ・エボラ流行に関連する背景情報として言及されているのみで、現在進行中のイベントの主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Prague hospital tests woman for dangerous tropical diseases after
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-02, a woman who recently returned from Uganda was admitted to Prague's Bulovka University Hospital with suspected symptoms of a highly dangerous infectious disease. The Health Ministry said the likelihood of infection is very low and stressed there is no risk to the public. Test results are expected on Sunday. Public health director Matyáš Fošum noted she spent about two weeks in Uganda on an organized tour, had no contact with local residents, and returned on July 29, developing a fever afterward. Ebola is considered unlikely because she stayed in the Bwindi region, about 700 kilometres from the Ituri area of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where most current Ebola cases have been reported. The hospital has sent samples to the Robert Koch Institute in Berlin for standard testing for Marburg, Lassa, dengue and Ebola viruses.

triage.headline_ja: プラハの病院、ウガンダ旅行後の女性を危険な熱帯感染症検査
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ旅行後の発熱女性がマールブルグ・ラッサ・デング・エボラの検査対象となったが、当局はリスクを低いと評価し確定診断は未確定のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 患者はウガンダのブウィンディ地域に滞在しており、DRCのイトゥリ地域(現行エボラ流行地)からは約700km離れているため、DRCでの発生とは無関係。ウガンダ・チェコ・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。検査結果待ちの段階であり、確定診断が出次第再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Rubella Bertambah, Pemkab Bantul Percepat Imunisasi Anak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rubella Cases Rise, Bantul Regency Government Accelerates Child Immunization.
article.articleSummary: Rubella cases rise in Bantul Regency, Indonesia, prompting strengthened prevention via School Immunization Month (BIAS) beginning August 2026. Measles-Rubella (MR) vaccine will be administered to nine‑month-olds, 18-month-olds, and primary school students according to the national schedule, with phased distribution to puskesmas; phase one already in August and phase two in November. In 2026, Bantul targets MR immunization for tens of thousands: 8,410 nine‑month infants, 9,418 toddlers up to 18 months, and 12,710 primary school children through BIAS. The vaccine schedule is at 9 months, again at 18 months, and in Grade 1 for ongoing protection and herd immunity. Rubella can cause Congenital Rubella Syndrome, leading to fetal abnormalities; vaccination also aims to safeguard pregnant women. By August 2026, Bantul reports 35 rubella cases, up from 14 in 2025, with officials noting no epidemiologic link between cases.

triage.headline_ja: 風疹症例増加、バントゥル県政府が子どもの予防接種を加速
triage.triage_reason: バントゥル県で風疹症例が2025年の14例から2026年35例に増加しており注視が必要だが、症例間の疫学的関連はないとされ、国際的拡大や重篤性の証拠はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（バントゥル県）が予防接種強化策（BIAS）を実施している段階であり、先天性風疹症候群（CRS）リスクへの言及はあるが具体的な妊婦感染例の報告はない。続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Ne le opekline in vročina: poletje prinaša skriti val nalezljive otroške bolezni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not only burns and fever: summer brings a hidden wave of infectious childhood diseases.
article.articleSummary: Summer conditions drive a hidden wave of infectious childhood diseases, notably hand, foot and mouth disease caused by Coxsackie viruses (enteroviruses), primarily affecting children under five. The infection is highly contagious and spreads through respiratory droplets and direct/contact with contaminated surfaces; the virus most often enters via the eyes, nose, or mouth. Incubation is 3–5 days. Early warning signs include dehydration (refusing fluids, reduced urination) and apathy, followed by fever, sore throat, painful oral ulcers, and a maculopapular rash on the palms and soles that can extend to knees, elbows, and buttocks. Summer activities—pools, camps, daycare—facilitate transmission, especially with hot temperatures that promote viral replication (China 2020 study cited). Management is supportive: antipyretics/analgesics and strict hydration; no specific antiviral treatment or vaccine. Most cases resolve in 7–10 days with good hygiene and rest.

triage.headline_ja: 火傷や発熱だけではない：夏がもたらす小児感染症の隠れた流行
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は手足口病（コクサッキーウイルスによる小児感染症）に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の国・地域における具体的なアウトブレイク事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名は動物の口蹄疫（Foot And Mouth Disease）と誤分類されているが、記事内容は人間の手足口病（Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease）に関する一般的な季節性健康情報。中国の2020年の研究が引用されているのみで、実際の発生事象ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 中疾控：新冠病毒檢測陽性率20.3%　屬常規周期波動 (13:35) - 20260802 - 兩岸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: COVID-19 test positivity rate of 20.3% falls within normal cyclical fluctuations (13:35) - 20260802 - Cross-Strait
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 test positivity reached 20.3% in national sentinel hospital outpatient/emergency influenza-like illness samples for July 20–26, per China CDC, up from 16.3% the prior week. The epidemic remains at a moderate level, with NB.1.8.1 as the main circulating lineage. Geographically, southern provinces show higher positivity than the north. Since reclassifying COVID-19 as a Category B infectious disease with Class B management, China experiences 1–2 annual outbreak waves; the current rise mirrors the intensity of the past two years and is considered normal cyclical fluctuation. No variants with major public health risk detected, and the uptick has not disrupted overall medical services. Data released July 30 on the official site; reported by Yangcheng Evening News.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病予防管理局：新型コロナウイルス検査陽性率20.3%、通常の周期的変動の範囲内
triage.triage_reason: 中国CDC自身が「通常の周期的変動」と説明しており、重大な公衆衛生上のリスクを持つ変異株も検出されていない。医療体制への影響もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 季節性の定例モニタリング報告であり、新規変異株の出現や重症化増加の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: التفشي الحالي للإيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية هو الأكبر على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest ever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, is now the largest recorded outbreak. As of August 2, 2026, the DRC reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality 44%), surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak of 3,317 cases. The outbreak began in the Mungbalu Health Zone, Ituri Province, and has spread over two months to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Health workers account for 151 infections and 44 deaths. Ongoing insecurity, displacement, high mobility, and cross-border movement impede surveillance and response; attacks on health facilities further hamper detection. The WHO rates the national risk as very high and calls for a substantial expansion of surveillance, testing, clinical care, infection prevention and control, community engagement, and logistics to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国における現在のエボラ出血熱の流行は史上最大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行（3,605症例、致死率44%）が5州49保健地区に拡大しており、WHOが国家リスクを非常に高いと評価し国際支援を要請しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のエボラ出血熱流行。医療従事者151名感染・44名死亡、治安悪化・住民移動・医療施設への攻撃が対応を阻害しており、WHOは国家リスクを非常に高いと評価し監視・治療・IPC等の大幅拡充を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Sekda Kendari Buka Forum Kemitraan Pengendalian HIVAIDS, Tuberkulosis, dan Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kendari Regional Secretary Opens HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria Control Partnership Forum.
article.articleSummary: On August 2, 2026, Kendari City Secretary opened a Partnership Forum to accelerate control of HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis (TB), and Malaria in Kendari, Southeast Sulawesi, Indonesia. The event emphasizes cross-sector collaboration beyond the health sector, with participation from government agencies, private sector, civil society organizations, and communities to strengthen prevention and care systems. The forum aims to harmonize work programs, improve early detection, and provide patient support to ensure complete treatment, while addressing social stigma that hinders access to services. Officials highlighted commitment to national elimination targets for HIV/AIDS, TB, and malaria, and discussed more effective use of resources and budgeting, including data validation for policy decisions and efficient distribution of medicines. Attendees included the Health Department, other regional government agencies, and health development partners, with expectations that outcomes translate into concrete actions to improve public health in Kendari.

triage.headline_ja: ケンダリ市地域書記官、HIV/AIDS・結核・マラリア対策パートナーシップフォーラムを開催
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性感染症（HIV/AIDS、結核、マラリア）対策に関する行政フォーラム開催の報道であり、新規発生や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の公衆衛生プログラム（HIV/AIDS・結核・マラリアの制御）に関する行政的な連携フォーラムの開催報告であり、新規の感染症発生や異常事象ではないため対象国リストへの計上は行わない。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": تفشي "إيبولا" في الكونغو الديمقراطية يخرج عن السيطرة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is out of control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, according to the World Health Organization. In the past week, 567 new infections and 296 deaths were recorded—the highest weekly toll since the outbreak began—bringing confirmed cases to 3,605 and deaths to 1,587, with 651 recoveries. The rise reflects expanded spread and improved surveillance and testing. However, response teams are tracing only about 80% of contacts, a level insufficient to halt transmission. Security and humanitarian challenges—armed conflict, displacement, and restricted access to treatment centers—likely understate the true burden. The outbreak risks crossing borders, posing a threat to neighboring countries and underscoring the need for intensified containment and support.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行は制御不能に陥っている
triage.triage_reason: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を「制御不能」と表明し、致死率が高く週間新規感染・死亡数が過去最多を記録、国境を越えた拡大リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 武装紛争・住民避難により真の感染規模は過小評価されている可能性が高い。接触者追跡率が80%と不十分であり、封じ込めの遅れが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: ศูนย์วิทยาศาสตร์การแพทย์สุ่มตรวจ 'ปลานิล-กุ้งก้ามกราม' พบ 'เชื้อดื้อยา'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Center for Medical Science conducts random screening of Nile tilapia and giant river prawn; finds antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Center for Medical Science conducted random screening of Nile tilapia and giant river prawn, finding antibiotic‑resistant bacteria linked to environmental contamination and improper antimicrobial use in aquaculture. Consumers are advised to cook fish and shellfish thoroughly to reduce risk, with findings supporting integrated water monitoring and environmental management across supply chains. Environmental and economically important species—Nile tilapia, sea bass, giant river prawn, white shrimp, and black tiger shrimp—were tested for food-safety pathogens including E. coli and Salmonella, and other bacteria. Salmonella prevalence in aquaculture is <5%; no carbapenem resistance detected. Antimicrobial use in aquaculture has fallen >60% from 2017 to 2023; about 68.69% of farmers and staff practice rational antimicrobial use. Thailand’s AMR mortality is ~38,000/year (global ~1.27 million), with >40 billion THB annual economic loss. ONE HEALTH-based targets aim for a 10% reduction in AMR deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 医科学センター、ティラピアとテナガエビを無作為検査し薬剤耐性菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 薬剤耐性菌に関する定例的な食品安全モニタリング調査結果の報告であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は薬剤耐性菌（AMR）に関する養殖水産物の定期サーベイランス報告であり、抗菌薬使用量は2017-2023年で60%以上減少するなど改善傾向を示している。個別の食中毒事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: अचानकमार टाइगर रिजर्व क्षेत्र में मलेरिया का प्रकोप, अलर्ट मोड पर स्वास्थ्य विभाग और जिला प्रशासन
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria outbreak in the Achanakmar Tiger Reserve area, health department and district administration on high alert.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreak triggers a high-alert response in the Achanakmar Tiger Reserve area under Lormi block, Mungeli district, India. District Collector Kundan Kumar has ordered a wide-ranging malaria-control campaign emphasizing timely diagnosis and treatment to curb transmission. Administrative and health teams are conducting door-to-door surveys and visits to Tilaidabara, Bahoud, Sarasdol, Jamunahi, Atariyakhār, and Rajk villages to assess conditions, provide care, and ensure uninterrupted services. The health department reports all malaria patients are receiving treatment; severe cases are admitted to health facilities, while others are under regular monitoring. Rapid diagnostic test kits and anti-malarial medicines are stocked with frontline workers, including mitanins, for on-the-spot testing and treatment. A control room for continuous surveillance of malaria and other seasonal illnesses has been established. Authorities urge residents to wear long-sleeved clothing, use mosquito nets, keep surroundings clean, and drink boiled or safe water.

triage.headline_ja: アチャナクマール・タイガー・リザーブ地域でマラリアが流行、保健当局と郡行政が厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: インド中部の一地域（部族居住地域）における季節性マラリアの流行で、地元行政・保健部門により迅速診断・治療体制が敷かれているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、社会的関心も限定的と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの当該地域（部族居住区・タイガーリザーブ周辺）で季節的に発生する既知の風土病であり、郡行政・保健部門による地域内対応（迅速診断キット、抗マラリア薬の配備、戸別調査など）が進行中。重症患者は施設収容され、他は経過観察下にあるとされるが、患者数・死亡者数などの具体的な規模は記事に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: BMKG Kondisi Iklim Awal 2026 Berpotensi Tingkatkan Risiko Demam Berdarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BMKG Early 2026 Climate Conditions Could Increase Dengue Fever Risk.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rising in Indonesia in early 2026 due to a weak La Niña during the rainy season, BMKG says. Climate Outlook 2026: most of Indonesia 25-29 C (0.2-0.6 C warmer than normal). Increased rainfall and high humidity boost Aedes aegypti breeding. Regions at higher risk include Jakarta and Bali. In Jakarta, climate suitability for dengue is high; Jakarta Utara (North) projected to have the highest Incidence Rate among districts, followed by Jakarta Barat (West) and Jakarta Selatan (South); Jakarta Pusat (Central) and Jakarta Timur (East) lower. In Bali, climate suitability high (>90%) during peak rainy season January-February 2026; Gianyar and Klungkung highest IR around 10 per 100k; Jembrana and Buleleng lower risk. Even after peak rainfall (two to three months post), risk persists. Health departments urged to implement comprehensive dengue prevention through Vector Control (PSN) in Jakarta and Bali.

triage.headline_ja: BMKG、2026年初頭の気候条件がデング熱リスクを高める可能性
triage.triage_reason: 気候予測に基づく将来的なデング熱リスク上昇の予報であり、現時点で実際の患者急増や異常事態の報告ではないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は気象庁(BMKG)による季節予報・リスク予測であり、実際の症例数増加を報告するものではない。デング熱はインドネシアで毎年流行する既知の風土病であり、今回の情報は予防的な注意喚起に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Wabah ebola di Kongo yang terbesar dalam sejarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in Kongo is the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus is the largest outbreak in the country’s history. WHO states transmission remains ongoing with rising case numbers and deaths, and the outbreak has broadened geographically. As of July 30, 2026, there were 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 44%. This outbreak remains the largest recorded in the DRC. The continued surge signals a rapidly escalating public health emergency, marked by sustained spread and high mortality. The report highlights the severity of the situation and ongoing international and local response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴのエボラ流行は史上最大規模
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)の史上最大規模の流行が継続中で、致死率約44%、症例数・地理的拡大が進行しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の緊急事態である。
triage.notes: WHOにより史上最大のエボラ流行と発表。症例数3,605、死亡1,587、CFR約44%。地理的拡大と国際的な対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Hivatalos: soha nem volt pusztítóbb ebolajárvány Kongóban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Official: There has never been a more devastating Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing the most devastating Ebola outbreak in its history, according to the World Health Organization. By late July 2026, 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths were confirmed, a case fatality rate of about 44%. The outbreak, officially declared in mid-May 2026, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus. There is no licensed vaccine yet, though development is underway in Singapore and the United Kingdom. Historically, 2018–2020 brought a severe outbreak in the DRC, but current transmission has produced more infections. The WHO warns the crisis is not confined to Congo: 20 cases have been reported in Uganda and 1 in France, signaling cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: 公式発表：コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪のエボラ流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（症例3,605件、死亡1,587件、致死率約44%）が発生し、ウガンダやフランスへの越境拡大も報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（20例）とフランス（1例）への越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン未承認かつBundibugyo株による大規模流行であり、WHOも史上最悪と警告している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: le PAM réclame 76 millions USD pour renforcer la riposte face aux contraintes sécuritaires et financières
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WFP seeks 76 million USD to bolster the response amid security and financial constraints.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) faces funding and access constraints as the World Food Programme (WFP) issues an urgent appeal. As of August 2, 2026, the DRC hosts its 17th Ebola outbreak with new cases across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, and Haut-Uele, two months after declaration. The WFP warns that delays and resource gaps could compromise containment, surveillance, logistics, and essential humanitarian operations amid security constraints and restricted access. The agency seeks $101 million for six months to bolster the response, including $76 million for DRC operations; immediate food and nutrition needs total $50 million for hot meals, quarantine support, and aid to newly affected areas. Overall WFP needs in the DRC amount to $293.6 million for six months. Strikes in Ituri and attacks on treatment centers further complicate the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：WFPが治安・財政的制約下での対応強化のため7600万米ドルを要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行が5州に拡大し、治安・資金制約で封じ込めが困難な状況にあり、WFPが国際支援を要請していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 宣言から2ヶ月で5州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ、チョポ、ハウトウェレ）に拡大し、治療施設への攻撃や治安悪化で対応が阻害されている。WFPは6ヶ月間で1億100万米ドル（うちDRC向け7600万米ドル）を要請。

article.articleHeadline: कोल्हा चावला; 'रेबीज' घेऊनही जीव गेला; सीपीआरमध्ये केले होते उपचार : अर्जुनवाडा येथील दुर्दैवी शेतकरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bitten by a wolf; life lost despite rabies vaccination; CPR performed: the unfortunate farmer from Arjunwada
article.articleSummary: Dileep Dasharat Yadav, 56, a farmer from Arjunwada in Raadhanagari Taluka, Kolhapur district, died during treatment after a wolf bite on November 12, 2025. He sustained a fractured thumb in the attack while drying pajar in his field. He was admitted to CPR and received rabies vaccine along with other immunizations during an eight-day hospital stay before discharge. Four days before his latest admission, he developed symptoms—reported hydrophobia-like signs when seeing water—and was readmitted on Thursday. He died on Saturday while still under treatment. The forest department was informed; officials said their six-month responsibility had ended. Dr. Sadanand Bhise of Rajarshi Shahu Chhatrapati Government Medical College, Kolhapur, said the exact cause cannot yet be determined pending a review of the patient file and treating doctors’ inputs. The article emphasizes administering rabies vaccine within 24 hours of a wolf bite.

triage.headline_ja: 狼に噛まれ、狂犬病ワクチン接種も死亡；CPRで治療：アルジュンワダの不運な農民
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける個別の狂犬病死亡症例であり、風土病として異常性が低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない単発事例のため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドの風土病であり、本記事は単一患者の死亡事例報告。ワクチン接種後の死亡という点で医療的関心はあるが、公衆衛生上の危機的シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Wabak Ebola di Congo terbesar pernah direkodkan: WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Largest Ebola outbreak in Congo ever recorded: WHO.
article.articleSummary: 3,605 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%) reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of July 30, 2026, marking the largest outbreak in the country. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak originated in Mongbwalu health zone, Ituri province, and has spread over two months to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Healthcare workers account for 151 infections and 44 deaths. The ongoing outbreak surpasses the 2018–2020 eastern Congo outbreak, which recorded 3,317 confirmed cases. Insecurity, population displacement, and cross-border movement hinder surveillance and response, with attacks on health facilities limiting access for response teams and elevating transmission risk in conflict-affected areas lacking essential services such as healthcare, clean water, food, and shelter.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行、過去最大規模を記録：WHO
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（3,605例確認、致死率44%）が発生し、49の保健地区・5州に拡大、医療従事者感染や紛争地域での対応困難も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOが過去最大規模と公式に認定した流行であり、致死率44%、医療従事者感染151例、紛争・治安悪化による対応阻害が報告されている。国境を越えた人の移動が言及されており国際拡大リスクも懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 中 독감유사환자 중 코로나양성률 20% 넘어...당국 "통상적 수준"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 positivity rate among influenza-like illness patients in China exceeds 20%... authorities say it's at a 'normal level'.
article.articleSummary: On August 2, 2026, China’s CDC reported rising COVID-19 positivity among influenza-like illness (ILI) patients, reaching 20.3% for the week of July 20–26, 2026—a 4-point rise from the prior week. Among respiratory samples from outpatient and emergency department ILI visits, about one in five tested positive for SARS-CoV-2. Authorities described the rise as mid-level and within normal seasonal fluctuation, noting similar patterns over the past two years. Most infections are mild, but the elderly and those with chronic conditions remain at risk of progression to severe disease. The NB.1.8.1 lineage is the predominant variant. Positivity is higher in southern China than in northern regions, and is more common among adults aged 15–59. The report emphasizes rate changes over case counts or deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、インフルエンザ様疾患患者のうちコロナ陽性率が20%超え…当局「通常のレベル」
triage.triage_reason: 当局が季節的な通常範囲内と説明しており、重症例や死亡の増加も報告されていないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 既知の変異株NB.1.8.1による季節的増加であり、当局は通常の範囲内と評価。重症化リスクは高齢者・基礎疾患保有者に限定的。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تعلن أن التفشي الحالي للإيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية هو الأكبر على الإطلاق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Health Organization announces that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest on record.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization states that the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is the largest ever reported, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak that had 3,317 confirmed cases. As of last Thursday, there are 3,605 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, yielding a case-fatality rate of 44%. In the most recent epidemiological week (week 30), 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported, underscoring unusually rapid transmission. Geographic spread has expanded to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Ouïli, and Chobo—now affecting 49 health zones. Local authorities, with WHO and partners, continue wide-ranging response measures, but a substantial scale-up of activities is needed. WHO reiterates the need to sustain intensified surveillance, preparedness, and cross-border health-security measures amid ongoing population movement and cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、コンゴ民主共和国における現在のエボラ出血熱の流行が過去最大規模であると発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最大規模と認定したエボラ流行であり、致死率44%、5州49保健区域に拡大し越境感染リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola（Cuanza Norte Province）が含まれているが、記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国のみを主題としており、アンゴラでの発生には言及がないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Tetapkan Wabah Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo Terburuk dalam Sejarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo the Worst in History.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is declared the worst on record. By 30 July 2026, the outbreak has 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (44% CFR), surpassing the 2018–2020 epidemic (~3,500 cases and ~2,300 deaths). First announced 15 May 2026, it has intensified with 567 new cases and 296 deaths in the past week. The epicenter is Ituri Province in eastern DRC, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, areas partially controlled by the M23 armed group. Insecurity, population displacement, and cross-border movement hinder control. There is no approved vaccine or therapy yet; candidate vaccines are under development in Singapore, with other trials in the United Kingdom. Outside DRC, Uganda reports 20 cases and France 1; two patients diagnosed in DRC have been treated in Germany. Transmission is via contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行を史上最悪と宣言
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最悪規模(3,605症例、致死率44%)のエボラ流行が発生し、ウガンダ・フランス・ドイツへの越境拡大、武装勢力による対応困難など国際的拡大リスクが極めて高いためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフランス、ドイツ、ウガンダ、シンガポール、英国が含まれるが、これらは輸入症例・ワクチン開発拠点であり流行の主体はDRCのみ。主体国DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。WHOによる公式なPHEIC宣言の有無は記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: 中 독감유사환자 중 코로나양성률 20% 넘어...당국 "통상적 수준"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 positivity rate among influenza-like illness patients in China exceeds 20%... authorities say it's a 'normal level'.
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 positivity among influenza-like illness (ILI) patients rose to 20.3% in the fourth week of last month (20–26), according to the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention. Respiratory specimens from outpatient and emergency department ILI patients showed one in five tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 nationwide. The rate marks a 4 percentage-point increase from the prior week but is characterized by authorities as mid-level and within typical seasonal fluctuations; officials note the recent two-year trend is similar. Regionally, southern China recorded higher positivity than the north, and adults aged 15–59 had higher positivity than other ages.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のインフルエンザ様疾患患者における新型コロナウイルス陽性率が20%超...当局は「通常レベル」と説明
triage.triage_reason: 中国当局が季節的変動の範囲内かつ通常レベルと説明しており、重症例の急増や異常事態を示す情報がないため、緊急対応の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 季節性のCOVID-19/インフルエンザ様疾患の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、当局も「通常レベル」と明言している。NB.1.8.1系統が主流だが特段の重症化増加の報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Terbesar Sepanjang Sejarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Congo is the largest in history.
article.articleSummary: WHO designated the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the DRC has become the largest on record, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, 2026 (case fatality ~44%). In the past week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were reported, signaling ongoing, high transmission. The outbreak has expanded from Ituri to four additional provinces: North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo, affecting 49 health zones. WHO stresses a substantial scale-up of response efforts to halt transmission and reduce fatalities. The PHEIC status was declared May 17, 2026, reflecting international concern.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ流行、史上最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、史上最大規模のエボラ流行がDRCで拡大中で致死率も高く、複数国・複数州に拡大しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。PHEIC宣言済みでWHOが対応強化を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: 中 코로나 양성률 일주일 새 16.3%→20.3%...5명 중 1명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 test positivity rate rises from 16.3% to 20.3% in a week... one in five people.
article.articleSummary: China is experiencing a rebound in COVID-19 infections. In the week of July 20–26, 2026, the national COVID-19 test positivity rate rose to 20.3%, up from 16.3% the prior week, with higher rates in the southern regions and among people aged 15–59. Among influenza-like illness patients, about one in five tested positive. The surge is driven by the NB.1.8.1 lineage, with most infections being mild. Authorities describe the outbreak as a mid-level periodic wave but warn that older adults and individuals with chronic diseases can progress to severe illness. Data come from the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention. No details on imported or exported cases or new vaccines are provided; public health measures and vigilance for vulnerable populations are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、コロナ陽性率が1週間で16.3%→20.3%に上昇…5人に1人
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のCOVID-19再流行だが多くは軽症であり、IHR基準の該当は限定的。高齢者・基礎疾患患者への重症化リスクがあるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 中国CDCデータに基づく季節性COVID-19流行の報告。NB.1.8.1系統による中規模波と説明されており、大部分は軽症。高齢者・基礎疾患保有者への重症化に注意喚起がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Terbesar dalam Sejarah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo largest in history
article.articleSummary: WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo virus (BVD), is the largest on record in the country. As of July 30, 2026, the outbreak has 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths, for a case fatality rate of 44%. In the past week, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded, signaling sustained and rapid transmission. The outbreak has spread from Ituri province to four others—North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—affecting 49 health zones. WHO warns that intensified response is urgently needed to curb transmission. On May 17, the WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and regional risk of further spread remains high.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、史上最大規模
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、WHOがPHEICを宣言。致死率44%、複数州に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
