article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تدق ناقوس الخطر بشأن فيروس الإيبولا | مصراوي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization Sounds the Alarm on the Ebola Virus | Masrawy
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the worst on record, with the May 15, 2026 declaration followed by rapid escalation. As of July 30, 2026, WHO reports 3,605 confirmed infections and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%), caused by the Bundibugyo strain. The outbreak is expanding from Ituri province into North and South Kivu amid security and humanitarian crises that complicate response. Uganda has reported 20 linked cases; France has one imported case; two cases from DRC were treated in Germany. Weekly transmission remains exceptionally high: 567 new cases and 296 deaths in one week. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; vaccine candidates are under development in the UK and Singapore, with trials in the UK and progress in Singapore. Transmission begins with animal reservoirs, particularly fruit bats, then spreads via body fluids. Containment is challenged by displacement and cross-border movement.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、エボラウイルスに対して警鐘を鳴らす | Masrawy
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最悪規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が拡大中で、致死率約44%、国際的に複数国への拡散(ウガンダ、フランス、ドイツ)が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ株による過去最大規模の流行。治安・人道危機が対応を複雑化させている。フランス・ドイツ・ウガンダは輸入症例のため対象国リストに非該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 3 674 cas et 1 621 décès au 31 juillet, le Sud-Kivu rouvre son suivi des contacts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 3,674 cases and 1,621 deaths as of July 31, South Kivu reopens its contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (17th outbreak) totals 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths across five provinces as of July 31, with 69 new cases and 34 deaths that day. Lethality stands at 44.1%; 666 recovered; 760 in isolation. No new health zones; 49 of 140 zones affected. Tshopo adds a fifth zone, Wanie-Rukula, not yet included in totals. South Kivu reopens active surveillance, listing 78 contacts (55 active, 23 discharged) linked to a confirmed imported death from Tshopo; 41 under health supervision. In South Kivu, 11 tested samples were negative; Miti-Murhesa remains the only affected area. Ituri accounts for 87.9% of cumulative cases and 76.8% of daily confirmations (3,229 cases, 1,336 deaths; CFR 41.4%). Nord-Kivu has 378 cases, 251 deaths (CFR 66.4%). No vaccine in use; a vaccine candidate entered Phase 1 on July 24. Ongoing transmission fueled by movement and cross-border contacts with Uganda and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：7月31日時点で3,674例、1,621人死亡、南キブ州が接触者追跡を再開
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行が5州に拡大しており、ウガンダ・南スーダンとの越境接触も報告されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・南スーダンとの越境接触が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチンは未導入で第1相治験段階のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Parasita que devora animais vivos faz EUA investirem milhões
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parasite that feeds on living animals drives the U.S. to invest millions.
article.articleSummary: New World screwworm fly infestation prompts a US$25 million USDA investment to curb the parasite that feeds on living tissue. A sterile-insect technique will release millions of sterile males to mate with wild females, reducing reproduction. A new distribution unit will operate in Douglas, Arizona, near the US–Mexico border, to accelerate responses, alongside a large-scale production facility in Texas. The larvae infest wounds in cattle, sheep, goats, horses, and other warm-blooded animals, causing tissue destruction, secondary infections, weight loss, stress, and potentially death; wildlife and domestic pets can also be affected, with human cases rare. The strategy aims to bolster border defenses as new foci arise in Central America and Mexico, and to ease import restrictions on Mexican cattle gradually, with Douglas first to reopen. Brazil monitors closely, advising vigilant inspections and early diagnoses.

triage.headline_ja: 生きた動物を食い荒らす寄生虫、米国が対策に数百万ドル投資
triage.triage_reason: ラセンウジバエ（New World screwworm）による家畜被害に関する記事で、発生地域は米国・メキシコ・中米が中心。ヒトへの感染は稀とされ、対象国（ブラジル）は監視強化の立場であり実際の発生国ではないため対象外。
triage.notes: 主に家畜（牛・羊・馬等）に影響する寄生虫感染症で、ヒトへの感染は稀と明記。ブラジルは監視体制強化中であり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。対象国リストに該当する発生国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mysterious bird deaths trigger bird flu fears in Karnataka's Koppal
article.articleSummary: Bird flu fears surge as mysterious deaths of birds in Karnataka's Koppal district prompt calls for investigation. Over the past three months thousands of egrets nested behind the Koppal City Municipal Council office, but in the past week dozens of birds die daily and many weakened birds are seen falling from trees. Residents fear a link to avian influenza amid drought-like conditions, though authorities have not confirmed any cause and no lab tests have been conducted (blood or tissue samples). Criticism mounts toward Municipal authorities and the Animal Husbandry Department for not inspecting the site. With Koppal hosting many poultry farms, locals urge urgent inspection by the Health Department, Animal Husbandry Department, and municipal authorities to rule out bird flu and protect public health and the poultry industry. No official confirmation yet of avian influenza.

triage.headline_ja: カルナータカ州コッパルで謎の鳥類大量死、鳥インフルエンザへの懸念高まる
triage.triage_reason: 鳥の大量死が報告され鳥インフルエンザが疑われているが、検査が未実施で公式確認がなく、人への感染報告もないため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 検査（血液・組織サンプル）が未実施であり、鳥インフルエンザの公式確認は得られていない。コッパルには多数の養鶏場があり、確認された場合は家禽産業および公衆衛生への影響拡大の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns of intensifying Ebola outbreak in DR Congo as cases spread to five provinces
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding at an exceptional pace, spreading from the Mongbwalu area in Ituri to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé and Tshopo. As of July 30, 2026, DRC reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths; including two cases diagnosed in the DRC but treated in Germany, plus cases reported in Uganda and France, the global total stands at 3,626 cases and 1,589 deaths, with at least 651 recoveries in DRC and 18 in Uganda. This is the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC, surpassing 2018–2020. Since July 17, 2026, 1,481 new confirmed cases and 759 deaths have been reported, largely from outbreak expansion rather than surveillance alone. Response includes surveillance, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, clinical care, community engagement and logistics; substantial scaling up is needed. Uganda’s Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak ended July 28, but cross-border import risk remains; no travel restrictions are advised.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRCでエボラ出血熱流行の拡大を警告、5州に感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、国際的な症例輸出（ドイツ、ウガンダ、フランス）も発生しているため、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ドイツ・フランス・ウガンダでの症例は輸入例であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCが主要な発生国であることを確認。

article.articleHeadline: Climate change shifts malaria risk to southern, East Africa: Study
article.articleSummary: Malaria risk in Africa is shifting with climate change. The Nature study on childhood malaria in sub-Saharan Africa finds a slight overall increase but a reallocation of risk by region. In current hotspots—West Africa (Nigeria, Burkina Faso, Mali)—malaria cases may drop about 5% as temperatures rise, with Niger, Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, and Somalia potentially approaching elimination. Conversely, cooler regions such as southern Africa and high-elevation East Africa are becoming more suitable for mosquitoes, with about a 5% rise in the Ethiopian highlands (Kenya, Burundi) and similar increases in Angola, Zambia, and northeast South Africa; by 2100, Rift Valley and coastal southern Africa could see roughly a 20% rise. Limiting warming to 2°C could avert ~5 excess cases per 1,000 children in southern Africa and more in east African highlands. Adaptation and elimination efforts are emphasized as essential.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動によりマラリアリスクが南部・東アフリカへシフト：研究結果
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動とマラリアリスク分布の長期的変化に関する学術研究であり、急性のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature誌掲載の気候変動とマラリアリスクの地理的再分布に関する学術研究の紹介であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。Zambiaが将来のリスク増加地域として具体的に言及されているため対象国として抽出したが、対象国リスト外の複数国（ナイジェリア、ケニア、アンゴラ等）も含まれる広域研究である。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Bundibugyo di Republik Kongo Kian Meluas, 1.500 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Republic of the Congo spreads further, 1,500 people dead.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is expanding beyond Mongbwalu in Ituri to five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo—driven by sustained transmission. By 30 July 2026, there were 3,605 lab-confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%), the largest BVD outbreak ever reported in the DRC. In epidemiological week 30, 567 new cases and 296 deaths were recorded, the highest weekly totals so far. Ongoing insecurity, population displacement, and cross-border movement hinder response and raise the risk of further spread. Uganda reports its Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak ended on 28 July 2026 after 42 days without new locally transmitted cases; WHO will monitor for 42 days from that date to ensure no missed transmission chains. The agency reiterates the need for vigilant surveillance and stronger control measures amid continued cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョ・エボラ出血熱流行が拡大、死者1,500人
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行が5州に拡大し、致死率44%、週間新規感染・死者数が過去最多を記録しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は42日間新規感染なしで終息宣言されたが、WHOは42日間の監視継続中。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの越境移動や治安悪化による対応困難が国際的拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يواصل زحفه في الكونغو.. تحذيرات دولية من تفاقم الأزمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Continues Its Advance in the Congo; International Warnings About the Worsening Crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the worst Ebola outbreak on record there. The World Health Organization reports last week’s 567 new infections and 296 deaths, bringing laboratory-confirmed cases to 3,605 and deaths to 1,587, with 651 recoveries. Most rise stems from ongoing community transmission, despite expanded surveillance and testing. Only about 80% of contacts are being traced; reaching at least 95% is deemed necessary to halt transmission. Ongoing armed conflict, widespread displacement, and distrust of health authorities hinder access, surveillance, vaccination, and treatment. The outbreak surpasses the 2018–2020 surge (3,317 cases, >2,200 deaths) as the largest in the country; concerns persist about regional spread to neighboring countries, prompting calls for intensified international support and a faster, more effective response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴでの感染拡大続く…危機悪化への国際的警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中で、致死率が高く、コミュニティ内伝播が継続し、周辺国への拡大懸念と国際支援要請がなされている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2018-2020年の流行を上回る過去最大規模と報告。接触者追跡率80%（目標95%）、武力紛争・住民の医療不信が対応の障壁となっている。周辺国への拡大が懸念されているが、具体的な越境感染の確認情報はサマリー中にはない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Battles World's Second Largest Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak in the eastern provinces has become the world's second-largest, behind 2014-2016 West Africa. More than 3,500 infected and over 1,500 dead, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak. Caused by the Bundibugyo strain, it lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment; experimental vaccines are in trials but not widely available. WHO cautions actual infections may be higher due to insecurity and limited surveillance, hindering contact tracing and reaching communities. The outbreak spans multiple provinces amid displacement and attacks on treatment centers, complicating response. Funding shortfalls hamper operations; about $1.4 billion is needed to fully contain it. Although centered in DRC, cross-border spread is a concern; Uganda had imported cases but was outbreak-free after 42 days, with continued border surveillance. Regional risk is very high; international risk lower thanks to surveillance and travel monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、世界第2位の規模となるエボラ流行と闘う
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで世界第2位規模の流行となり、死者1,500人超・感染者3,500人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、国境を越えた拡大リスクや治安・資金不足による対応困難がありIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境例があったが42日間新規感染なしで流行終息と記載されているため、DRCのみを主題国として検証。アンゴラは記事本文に具体的言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : "La population a manipulé le corps sans vie et des tirs de sommation ont éclaté", à Kasitu, près de Beni, l'équipe d'enterrements sécurisés attaquée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: "The population handled the dead body and warning shots were fired," in Kasitu, near Beni, the safe burial team was attacked.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists with security and community-acceptance challenges. On July 29, in Kasitu near Beni (Nord-Kivu), the dignified and safe burials team, escorted by security, was attacked during burial of a confirmed case; the crowd handled the corpse and warning shots dispersed the disturbance; no injuries or damages reported. The incident is described in a section on security and community acceptance alongside four other situations. Ituri reports 3,061 death alerts and 2,496 safe burials between May 20 and July 30; on July 30, 72 new alerts were added, 54 burials (56%), 12 failures, 31 postponements; 42 post-mortem samples taken, 30 in the community. Nord-Kivu logs 33 death alerts, all 33 corpses sampled and secured, 31 burials; 16 corpses pending. National totals: 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths. The report urges engaging religious/community leaders, securing burial teams, and expanding capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：「住民が遺体を扱い、威嚇射撃が発生」ベニ近郊カシツで安全埋葬チームが襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の継続的アウトブレイクで確定症例3,674例・死亡1,621例に達し、埋葬チームへの襲撃など地域社会の受容問題・治安上の課題が深刻化しており、国際的拡大・管理困難リスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は既に国家的緊急事態であり、埋葬チームへの襲撃は地域社会の受容不足と感染拡大リスクを示す重大な兆候。フルRRAへの移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Haut-Uélé : un seul laboratoire fonctionne sur les treize prévus, huit échantillons sur dix-sept analysés le 31 juillet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: only one laboratory is operating out of the thirteen planned; eight of seventeen samples analyzed on July 31.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Haut-Uélé, Democratic Republic of Congo, as of 31 July 2026 shows a critical diagnostic bottleneck with limited laboratory capacity. Only one of thirteen planned labs is operational (Isiro’s Université Cliniques de l’Uélé); Wamba and Boma Mangbetu remain planned, with a 10 kW solar kit received from WHO. Seventeen samples were received 31 July; eight analyzed, four positive (three in Isiro, one in Pawa), one invalid; nine pending. The outbreak began on 4 July via imported cases from Nia-Nia, Ituri. Cumulatively, 57 confirmed cases and 28 deaths (case fatality: 49.1%), across five health zones: Boma Mangbetu, Isiro, Pawa, Rungu, Wamba. Four new confirmations that day; no deaths validated. Contact tracing is 66.7% (375/562); Rungu provides no usable data. Five treatment centers with 68 beds hold 37 in isolation (16 confirmed, 21 suspects); Wamba exceeds confirmed capacity (125%), Boma Mangbetu is understaffed. Calls to accelerate decentralized testing, strengthen cross-border coordination, and expand entry-point readiness in Haut-Uélé and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: オー・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：計画された13の検査施設のうち稼働しているのは1つのみ、7月31日時点で17検体中8検体を分析
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラアウトブレイクにおいて、致死率49.1%（57症例中28死亡）という深刻な状況に加え、検査能力の著しい不足と国境を越えた拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 既知のエボラアウトブレイクの続報記事だが、致死率が非常に高く（49.1%）、13施設中1施設のみ稼働という診断能力の深刻な不足、Rungu地域でのデータ欠如、Wamba治療センターの収容超過（125%）など、対応能力の限界を示す内容であり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。国境を越えた症例（Nia-Nia, Ituriからの輸入例）も指摘されており、越境調整強化の呼びかけがある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Kivu : cinq ambulances sur trente, aucun corbillard sur vingt, deux centres de traitement aux normes sur onze
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in North Kivu: five ambulances out of thirty, no hearses out of twenty, two Ebola treatment centers meeting standards out of eleven.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, reports degraded Ebola outbreak logistics as of July 30–31. Only 5 of 30 ambulances are functional; 0 of 20 hearses; 2 Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs) meeting standards out of 11; no standard Transit Centers among 36. Isolation centers operate at 139% occupancy, with 27 confirmed and 169 suspected cases, plus 4 deaths and 2 recoveries. Cumulative confirmed admitted to treatment centers: 142 cases, 48 deaths (in-centre mortality 34%); 13 lost to follow-up. Provincial fatality is 66.4% (378 confirmed, 251 deaths), higher than Ituri’s 41.4%. On July 31, 12 new cases were reported in Beni, Katwa, Butembo, Kalunguta and Musienene; 9 deaths, including 5 in the community. Alerts total 1,033, with 852 investigated. Travelers screened: 59,834, 97.4% tested; 15 of 16 border posts transmitted data. Contact tracing at 74.7% (below 95%). Actions include supplies to Musienene, medicines from health program, UNFPA dignity kits; urgent ETC expansion; two health facilities burned in Butembo.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州のエボラ出血熱：救急車30台中5台のみ稼働、霊柩車20台中0台、基準を満たす治療センターは11カ所中2カ所
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、致死率66.4%と極めて高く、医療物流（救急車・霊柩車・治療センター）が著しく機能不全であり、接触者追跡率も目標を下回るなど流行制御に深刻な支障が生じている。
triage.notes: 州全体の致死率66.4%（378例確定、251死亡）はイツリ州（41.4%）より高く、医療インフラ（救急車・霊柩車・治療施設）の著しい不足と接触者追跡率の低さ（74.7%、目標95%未満）が指摘されている。ブテンボでは医療施設2カ所が焼失するなど治安・社会的混乱も懸念される。既知の継続中エボラアウトブレイクであり、既存のRRA対象である可能性が高いが、状況悪化の兆候として要フォロー。

article.articleHeadline: Leucemia, sida, moquillo y sarna: enfermedades transmitidas por perros y gatos domésticos amenazan a los felinos salvajes | Lecturas ambientales
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leukemia, AIDS, Canine Distemper, and Mange: Diseases Transmitted by Domestic Dogs and Cats Threaten Wild Felines | Environmental Readings
article.articleSummary: Domestic dogs and cats in Latin America are transmitting viruses, bacteria, fungi, and parasites to wild felids, threatening jaguars, pumas, ocelots, margays, oncillas, jaguarundis. Diseases include feline leukemia virus (FeLV), feline immunodeficiency virus (FIV, 'feline AIDS'), feline panleukopenia (FPV), canine distemper virus (CDV), rabies, and mange. In Mexico's Chamela-Cuixmala reserve, a jaguar death could mean a 20% local population loss. In Ecuador, 87.5% of ocelots tested FeLV positive and 23.5% CDV positive. In Bolivia, a wild cat raised in captivity contracted panleucopenia and died. In Chile, colocolo cats face FeLV and antibiotic-resistant bacteria. In Brazil, jaguar, puma, ocelot, and pampas cat populations face FeLV, FIV, FPV, rabies, CDV, and other infections due to habitat loss increasing contact with domestic animals. In Costa Rica, the La Amenaza Invisible project detected FeLV and FIV in pets near wild felids, prompting calls for vaccination and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 白血病、エイズ、ジステンパー、疥癬：家庭犬猫由来の疾患が野生ネコ科動物を脅かす｜環境レポート
triage.triage_reason: 野生ネコ科動物（ジャガー、ピューマ等）の保全に関する記事であり、人の公衆衛生への直接的な影響は報告されていないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本記事は野生ネコ科動物の保全問題であり、人獣共通感染症（狂犬病等）のリスクはあるが人での症例報告はない。動物カテゴリのみの影響であり公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la Tshopo déclare une cinquième zone de santé atteinte, que les cumuls nationaux n'enregistrent pas encore
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Tshopo declares a fifth health zone affected, not yet recorded in national totals.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: In Tshopo province, the seventh confirmed case was validated July 29 in Wanie-Rukula health zone, southeast of Kisangani, raising five zones affected in the province. National totals: 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths across 49 health zones (50 provincially). Tshopo reports seven confirmed cases, five deaths and one recovered (case fatality rate 71.4%), the highest nationally. July 31 alerts were not transmitted; only four of 19 risk checkpoints were active; no sampling reported and Kabondo contact tracing remained at zero. IPC kits were delivered to the contested zone; a site for a large-capacity treatment center was visited with COUSP, IMA, and MSF. Logistics show four vehicles, four motorcycles and four ambulances; needs are ten vehicles and 27 motorcycles. Bundibugyo strain lacks approved vaccines or treatments; vaccines exist for Ebola-Zaire. Ubundu territory, about 60 km SE of Kisangani.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:トショ州で5番目の保健地域感染確認、国内集計にはまだ反映されず
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続・拡大しており、致死率71.4%と高く、承認された治療薬・ワクチンがなく、監視体制の不備（警報未伝達、検問所稼働不足、接触者追跡停止）も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・治療薬がなく、既存のエボラ・ザイール株用ワクチンは適用外。監視体制の機能不全（警報未伝達、検問所4/19稼働、サンプリングなし、接触者追跡ゼロ）が拡大リスクを高めている。国際機関（MSF、COUSP、IMA）が既に対応支援中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : 141 soignants et prestataires confirmés, 41 morts, une létalité de 29,1 %
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: 141 healthcare workers and providers confirmed, 41 dead, a case fatality rate of 29.1%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 31 July (Situation Report No. 78). Healthcare workers: 141 confirmed infections and 41 deaths (case fatality rate 29.1%), up from 137/41 the previous day. Mongbwalu zone updated to 21 confirmed and 10 recovered due to ventilation changes, not new infections. Overall outcomes: 72 recovered, 25 hospitalized, 41 deaths; 3 cases with unknown status. By zone: Bunia 35 cases (14 deaths; 19 recovered), Rwampara 33 (7 deaths), Mongbwalu 21 (9 deaths), Nyankunde 14 (2 deaths); Nia-Nia 20 confirmed (1 recovered, 4 deaths, 13 hospitalized); Nizi 3 confirmed (3 deaths). Triage/infection-prevention coverage remains limited (181 of 1,170 units; 34% complete); 180 providers trained; 39 facilities monitored. North Kivu: 11 confirmed (3 deaths); Haut-Uele: 3 cases (1 hospitalized). These 141 healthcare workers represent 4.4% of Ituri's 3,229 cases; CFR 29.1% vs 41.4% in the population. Since 25 July, 18 new confirmations and 5 more deaths; national total 3,674.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：医療従事者141人感染確認、41人死亡、致死率29.1%
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCイツリ州で継続的に拡大しており、医療従事者感染や高い致死率が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域にルワンダ（Kigali Province, Republic of Rwanda）が含まれるが、記事本文・サマリーではルワンダに関する言及がなく、主題はDRCイツリ州の状況報告（Situation Report No.78）であるため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يواصل زحفه في الكونغو تحذيرات دولية من تفاقم الأزمة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues its advance in the Congo; international warnings of the worsening crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues its advance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with growing international warnings about a worsening crisis. As of August 2, 2026, the World Health Organization cautions that containment remains difficult as Ebola infections and related deaths continue to rise despite intensified health efforts on the ground. The report emphasizes sustained transmission within the DRC and the ongoing strain on health systems amid the outbreak. Global health authorities urge accelerated, coordinated international support to contain the outbreak, prevent further spread, and bolster response capacity in affected provinces. The piece summarizes the gravity of the outbreak and calls for immediate, sustained action by national and international actors.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が拡大を続ける、危機悪化への国際的警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで継続的に拡大し、WHOが封じ込め困難を警告、国際支援が求められている状況であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数・発生州の記載がなく、詳細情報は続報待ちが必要。WHOによる正式声明の裏付け確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: SP intensifica vacinação contra o sarampo na segunda (3); casos chegam a 15 | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo intensifies measles vaccination on Monday (3); cases reach 15 | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination is being intensified in São Paulo state from Aug 3 as part of the Expanded Multivaccination Campaign, running through Sept 1 across 645 municipalities. The effort follows the confirmation of the 15th measles case in 2026, in Guarulhos, involving an unvaccinated child. The campaign targets children and adolescents under 15, urging guardians to bring vaccination cards to update overdue doses. In São Paulo state, Guarulhos, and São Bernardo do Campo, the tríplice viral (MMR) vaccine will be offered to everyone aged 6 months to 59 years, regardless of vaccination history, to expand protection amid suspected transmissions linked to importation. A 6–11 month dose zero is available but not a substitute for 12 and 15‑month doses. State provisional coverage: 77.5% first dose, 65.5% second; target 95%. In the city of São Paulo, Dia D is Aug 22 with 483 UBSs open (7:00–19:00), and vaccination includes multiple vaccines beyond MMR.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州、月曜(3日)から麻疹ワクチン接種を強化;症例数15件に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル対象国だが症例数15件と限定的で、州が予防接種キャンペーンで積極対応中。WHO通知基準は満たさないが輸入例による伝播疑いがあり経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mainland China coronavirus infection rate exceeds 20% (21:43) - 20260802 - Cross-Strait
article.articleSummary: Mainland China reports COVID-19 positivity rate above 20% for the first time in national sentinel surveillance of acute respiratory infections (Week 30: July 20–26, 2026). The positivity rate rose by four percentage points from the prior week, meaning about one in five individuals tested were positive. Southern provinces show higher positivity than northern regions. Infections are most common among ages 0–4, 15–59, and 60+, comprising the majority of reported cases. The China CDC characterizes this rise as a cyclical seasonal fluctuation, with no change in disease severity and no emergence of a variant with major public health risk. No urgent public health threats identified. The update was published August 2, 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 中国CDCは季節性の周期的変動と説明しており、重症度の変化や新規変異株の出現もなく、緊急の公衆衛生上の脅威とは認定されていない既知疾患のルーチンサーベイランス報告のため。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、当局は季節性変動として説明。重症度上昇や新規変異株の懸念は明記されておらず、通常のサーベイランス報告と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: الإيبولا يجتاح الكونغو: تفشٍ قياسي يثير مخاوف عالمية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Congo: a record-breaking outbreak raises global concerns.
article.articleSummary: Unprecedented Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo becomes the largest in the country’s history. By July 30, 2026, confirmed cases total approximately 3,605 with 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%). The outbreak began May 15, 2026, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for this strain; research is advancing in the United Kingdom and Singapore, with a vaccine reportedly developed in Singapore and another vaccine in clinical trials in the UK. Security challenges and displacement in Ituri province have hampered response and facilitated spread to other areas such as the Kivu region. Imported/exported cases have been reported in Uganda and France, signaling cross-border risk. Ebola virus typically transmits from animals to humans; initial symptoms include fever and headache and can progress to bleeding. Across Africa, the virus has claimed about 15,000 lives in the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴを席巻:過去最大規模の流行が世界的懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率約44%、国境を越えた感染例(ウガンダ、フランス)も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・フランスへの越境症例は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認されたワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点、セキュリティ上の課題により対応が阻害されている点も重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Προσοχή στα τσιμπούρια - Μεταφέρουν ιούς όπως τον Bourbon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Watch out for ticks - they carry viruses such as the Bourbon virus.
article.articleSummary: Bourbon virus, a rare RNA virus in the Orthomyxoviridae family (thogotovirus), was first identified in Kansas in 2014. Transmission to humans occurs solely via tick bites, with no evidence of human-to-human spread. The primary vector is the lone star tick, Amblyomma americanum, which has no stable populations in Europe or Russia and is not endemic there. A rare New York case revived concern, but there is no confirmed Bourbon virus circulation on European or Russian soil. Infected individuals typically develop high fever, severe weakness, headache, myalgia, nausea/vomiting, and rash, with leukopenia and thrombocytopenia. There is no vaccine or specific antiviral therapy; care is supportive. Other tick-borne diseases are present in Europe and Eurasia: Greece reports Lyme disease and tick-borne encephalitis from local ticks, not Bourbon virus; Russia has Ixodes persulcatus and I. ricinus spreading tick-borne encephalitis and borreliosis, while Hyalomma in southern areas can transmit Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever.

triage.headline_ja: ダニに注意 - ボーボンウイルスなどのウイルスを媒介する
triage.triage_reason: 米国で2014年に発見されたボーボンウイルス等ダニ媒介感染症に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや対象国での発生報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はギリシャの一般啓発記事で、Bourbonウイルスは米国（カンザス・ニューヨーク）で確認された事例のみに言及。タイ・ロシア・ギリシャはダニ媒介感染症の一般的な文脈で言及されているが、Bourbonウイルスの発生国ではなく、対象国リストのタイも記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Com casos de sarampo em SP, Secretaria de Saúde reforça atualização da vacinação em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases in São Paulo prompt Health Department to reinforce vaccination update in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in São Paulo prompt Mato Grosso do Sul to reinforce vaccination. After measles was identified in São Paulo state — in Guarulhos, São Bernardo do Campo, and São Paulo city — the Health Ministry urged expanding vaccination to all people aged 6 months to 59 years in those municipalities to curb spread amid high international travel. Although not a severe outbreak, keeping immunization up to date is emphasized to prevent reintroduction in Brazil. MS borders SP transmission zones, underscoring vaccination importance in the state. In Epidemiological Week 28, 2026, MS reported 14 suspected measles cases; 11 were discarded and 3 are under investigation. Last confirmed MS cases occurred in 2019 (2 in Três Lagoas, 2 in Campo Grande) and in 2020 (10 in Campo Grande). The MMR vaccine protects against measles, mumps, and rubella; children receive two doses at 12 and 15 months; adults 1–29 years two doses, 30–59 one dose if not previously vaccinated; 60+ not routine. First-dose coverage for 12-month-olds reached 90.3% by May 2026; target ≥95%.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州での麻疹症例を受け、マットグロッソ・ド・スル州保健局がワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州での麻疹発生を受けた予防的なワクチン強化措置であり、重症例や大規模流行は報告されていないが、国境を接する州への波及リスクと接種率不足があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州（Guarulhos、São Bernardo do Campo、São Paulo市）での麻疹確認を受け、隣接するマットグロッソ・ド・スル州が予防的ワクチン接種強化を実施。同州では2026年第28週に疑い14例中11例が否定、3例調査中。重症流行ではないが再導入リスクとワクチン接種率（90.3%、目標95%未達）が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 1.621 la cifra de muertos y a 3.674 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raises the death toll to 1,621 and the confirmed Ebola cases to 3,674.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 3,674 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths as of August 2, 2026, a case-fatality rate of 44.1%. The seventeenth outbreak began May 15 in the eastern provinces, with Ituri as the epicenter, spreading to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. About 760 patients remain hospitalized or in isolation; 666 have recovered. The World Health Organization notes this is the fastest-spreading outbreak in the DRC’s history. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. Cross-border transmission reached Uganda, which later declared an end to its emergency after 42 days without new cases. Local authorities continue contact tracing, psychosocial support, and risk communication to reinforce prevention. The WHO assigns low global risk but high regional risk in sub-Saharan Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ死者数を1,621人、確定症例数を3,674人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最速拡大とされるエボラ流行が続き、致死率44.1%、越境感染も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されたが既に非常事態終了と記載されており、対象国リストにも含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内（Ituri, North/South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo）で拡大継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 中國COVID-19感染率升破20％
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's COVID-19 infection rate exceeds 20%
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 infection rate exceeded 20% positivity in the week of July 20–26, 2026, per the National Sentinel Surveillance for Acute Respiratory Infections (Week 30, 2026) published by the China CDC. The positivity rate rose to over 20% for the first time, up four percentage points from the prior week, meaning about one in five tests were positive. Southern provinces showed higher positivity than northern provinces. Most detected cases occurred in age groups 0–4, 15–59, and 60+. The China CDC described the rise as a periodic seasonal fluctuation with an intensity similar to the previous two years, and noted no change in illness severity or emergence of a novel variant with major public health risk. No case or death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のCOVID-19感染率が20%を突破
triage.triage_reason: 陽性率が初めて20%を超えたが、中国CDCは季節性変動の範囲内で重症度変化や新変異株の出現もないとしており、現時点でIHR基準の該当は乏しいため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 中国CDCは陽性率上昇を過去2年と同程度の季節性変動と説明し、重症度の変化や新規変異株の出現は認めていない。症例数・死亡数のデータは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la mise en place d'un centre d'isolement recommandée aux frontières avec l'Ituri - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The Establishment of an Isolation Center Recommended at the Borders with Ituri.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a Beni-based notable urged authorities to establish an Ebola isolation center and an Ebola treatment center at the two main border checkpoints between North Kivu and Ituri—Eringeti in the north and Mangina to the west. The proposal aims to reduce internal resource strain by placing non-corrupt personnel at border barriers to screen suspects in vehicles and motorcycles arriving from Ituri; suspected cases would be isolated on-site pending test results. He highlighted the role of humanitarian partners, noting Médecins Sans Frontières provides care to patients in isolation during entry and exit. The advocate plans to press authorities to implement the setup, adjusting actions as results dictate. As of July 29, roughly 350 confirmed Ebola cases had been reported in this region, underscoring ongoing calls for barrier measures, regular handwashing, and avoiding contact with unknown individuals.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：イトゥリ州との境界に隔離センター設置を勧告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部（北キブ州・イトゥリ州境界）で約350人のエボラ確定症例が報告されており、国境を越えた感染拡大のリスクと重症度の高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は北キブ州とイトゥリ州の境界（エリンゲティ、マンギナ）における越境感染防止のための隔離・治療センター設置を求める現地有力者の提言。国際NGO（国境なき医師団）が既に関与しており、350例という規模から継続的な監視とフルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Béni : le malade à l'origine d'altérations référé au centre de traitement Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: the patient at the origin of abnormalities referred to the Ebola treatment center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 2 August 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a woman ill with Ebola who sparked Saturday clashes at the La Joie medical center was referred to an Ebola treatment center. The patient was described as agonizing, and a center official termed the scene war-like, with projectiles and police warnings; protesters damaged an ambulance. The disturbances led to the suspension of Ebola response activities at the health center and at a new treatment center under construction, forcing workers to return home. The Ebola response coordination deployed teams to sensitize the population about the dangers of the virus and to counter pressure groups opposing the outbreak. This incident underscores ongoing security challenges amid Ebola response efforts in Beni.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:異常症状の原因となった患者がエボラ治療センターに搬送 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の患者搬送を巡り地域住民との衝突が発生し対応活動が一時停止するなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とアウトブレイク対応の実行可能性に懸念があるため。
triage.notes: エボラ治療施設への攻撃・抗議活動により対応活動が中断しており、コミュニティの抵抗が感染拡大リスクを高める可能性がある。続報でのケース数・地理的拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains out of control: WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, according to the World Health Organization. The outbreak is now the country’s largest ever, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths reported as of August 2, 2026, a case fatality rate of 44%. In epidemiological week 30, the outbreak recorded its highest weekly numbers, with 567 new cases and 296 deaths. WHO warns that case numbers are rising and geographic spread is widening, increasing the risk of cross-border transmission to neighbouring countries. Insecurity, population displacement, and high mobility are complicating response efforts and heightening transmission potential. The agency stresses the need for intensified outbreak control measures, enhanced surveillance, and cross-border coordination to prevent further escalation. As of August 2, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、依然として制御不能:WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ史上最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクで致死率44%、国境を越えた拡大リスクが指摘されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: WHOが国境を越えた感染拡大リスクと治安・人口移動の悪化による対応の複雑化を強調している。史上最大規模のアウトブレイクであり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Tchomia : 25 décès enregistrés sur 41 cas confirmés, létalité d'environ 61% (médecin chef de zone de santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tchomia: 25 deaths recorded out of 41 confirmed cases, case fatality rate of about 61% (health zone chief medical officer) - ACP
article.articleSummary: As of August 2, 2026, Ebola virus disease in Tchomia health zone, Ituri Province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, has 25 deaths among 41 laboratory-confirmed cases, a case-fatality rate of about 61%. Dr. Hervé Bavi, the zone’s chief medical officer, attributes the high CFR to delayed presentation to health facilities, noting many cases are identified only after death while contacts may already be exposed. He also highlights waning community adherence to hygiene practices, including handwashing and other preventive measures. Authorities urge the public to avoid self-medication and to promptly report suspected cases to health facilities for early care. Families should not keep sick individuals at home; health centers exist to admit patients and curb transmission. Ongoing vigilance and rapid reporting are essential to controlling the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:チョミアで確定症例41例中25人死亡、致死率約61%(保健地区首席医師)
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でエボラ出血熱の確定症例が発生し致死率約61%と極めて高く、地域社会での予防行動の低下や感染拡大リスクが指摘されているため、フルRRAへ移行すべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 致死率61%と非常に高く、遅延受診・自己治療・衛生行動の低下が指摘されており、地域内での感染拡大継続リスクが高い。国境地帯（Tchomia）での発生であり、国際的拡大リスクも考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: pourquoi la RD Congo peine à ralentir la progression de la maladie alors que l'Ouganda semble gagner la bataille
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: why the DRC is struggling to slow the progression of the disease while Uganda seems to be winning the battle
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda shows divergent trajectories as of July–August 2026. In the DRC, the Bundibugyo variant—devoid of a vaccine or treatment—drives a rapid surge declared May 15. By 30 July, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%) were reported across five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo; 151 health-care worker infections with 44 deaths. Ituri is under military administration amid armed conflict, with surveillance and contact tracing strained; the outbreak has expanded from Mongbwalu to additional regions. Uganda reports 20 cases and 2 deaths, with a rapid response including a Kampala treatment center; border closure and quarantine of over 6,000 contacts for 21 days. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28, but WHO cautions persistent cross-border risk and notes the end of the outbreak requires the 42-day waiting period without new cases."

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:ウガンダが勝利しつつある一方でDRCが感染拡大を抑制できない理由
triage.triage_reason: DRCでワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株による大規模エボラ流行が発生し、致死率約44%、医療従事者感染も多数。武力紛争下でサーベイランスが困難な状況が続き、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境）も確認されているため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ただしウガンダへの越境事例は国際的拡大の根拠として言及。武力紛争下でのサーベイランス困難、ワクチン・治療法不在という点で極めて深刻な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Anak Kembali Aktif Bersekolah, Jangan Lupakan Perlindungan dari Demam Berdarah Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kids Back in School, Don't Forget Protection Against Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: With the new school year underway in Indonesia, dengue fever remains a major risk for children. A study by Universitas Gadjah Mada estimates the national dengue burden for 2024 at nearly Rp9 trillion, covering treatment costs, transport, and lost parental income. Health Ministry data from 2018–2025 show deaths from dengue are concentrated in young people, with 59% of fatalities in 2025 among ages 0–14 and 41% in ages 5–14. Dengue is caused by four virus serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) and is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, most active in the morning and late afternoon—coinciding with school commute. Prevention at schools should remove standing water, conduct regular larval monitoring, and implement 3M Plus. Reinfection with a different serotype can occur and increases risk of severe dengue. Warning signs after fever ends include persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain, bleeding, lethargy, or altered consciousness; seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもたちが登校再開、デング熱からの防護を忘れずに
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事であり、新規の異常な流行や急増を示す情報はないが、既知の風土病として継続的な監視対象となる。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性・啓発的な内容であり、特定の異常な発生増加や新規事象を報じるものではない。デング熱は毎年インドネシアで発生する風土病であるため、通常の継続監視対象として扱う。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: l'épidémie actuelle d'Ebola devient la plus importante jamais enregistrée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the current Ebola outbreak becomes the largest ever recorded.
article.articleSummary: DRC's current Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has become the country’s largest on record. By July 30, 2026, there were 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (43.99% CFR). The earlier 2018–2020 outbreak in the east totaled 3,317 cases. Originating in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, the epidemic has spread over two months to 49 health zones across five provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo. Healthcare workers account for 151 infections and 44 deaths, underscoring persistent infection prevention and control gaps in health facilities. Insecurity, population mobility, and cross-border movements hinder surveillance and response; attacks on health facilities restrict access and raise the risk of undetected transmission in conflict-affected areas with limited water, food, and shelter. The WHO assesses the outbreak risk in the DRC as very high and calls for substantial strengthening of surveillance, screening, clinical care, IPC, community engagement, and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:現在のエボラ流行が過去最大規模に
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が発生し、致死率約44%、5州49保健地域に拡大、医療従事者感染も多数で国際的拡大・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: WHOはDRCにおけるアウトブレイクリスクを「非常に高い」と評価し、監視・臨床対応・IPC強化等の国際支援を要請している。治安不安と人口移動が対応を妨げている。

article.articleHeadline: 母女越南返台染登革熱！就醫未告知旅遊史　高市府開罰1萬元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mother and daughter who returned to Taiwan from Vietnam contract dengue fever! They did not disclose travel history when seeking medical care; Kaohsiung City Government fined NT$10,000.
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases confirmed in Kaohsiung City on August 2, 2026: a 37-year-old Vietnamese immigrant and her 13-year-old daughter, both residents of Dong’anli in Jiaxian District. They visited Vietnam July 2–24; after returning they developed fever, dizziness, and myalgia. The mother’s fever began July 26; she was diagnosed by PCR on July 31. The daughter developed fever July 28; PCR-confirmed dengue followed. Both are hospitalized under mosquito-control isolation. The Health Bureau fined the mother NT$10,000 for not disclosing travel history and hindering epidemiological investigation. Vector surveillance in Xi’anli and Dong’anli found elevated Aedes albopictus density: 60 and 30 households inspected yielded 10 and 22 positive containers, with adults captured. Breeding sites included tires, water barrels, pots, gutters, canvas water, and debris. Authorities urge “patrol, overturn, clean, scrub” and continue mosquito-density monitoring to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 母娘がベトナムから台湾に帰国後デング熱に感染！受診時に渡航歴を申告せず、高雄市政府が1万元の罰金
triage.triage_reason: 個別の輸入デング熱症例（母娘2名）であり、台湾国内でのローカル感染拡大は確認されていない。ベクター密度上昇への注意喚起はあるが、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾高雄市における輸入デング熱症例2例とその後のベクターサーベイランス。ベトナムは感染源として言及されているが、ベトナム国内での流行状況についての記述はなく、対象国としての主題性は認められないため除外。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tombol a járvány: 44 százalékos halálozási arány
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic is raging: 44 percent mortality rate.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) has reached 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of July 30, yielding a 44% case fatality rate. The Bundibugyo strain drives the surge, and there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment for this variant, though several therapeutic candidates are under evaluation. Reported mid-May, this is the country’s worst-known Ebola wave. Cases have also appeared abroad: 20 in Uganda and 1 in France; two patients diagnosed in Congo were treated in Germany. Symptoms begin with sudden fever, weakness, muscle and throat pain, later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash and kidney/liver dysfunction; some patients experience bleeding. Incubation spans 2–21 days. WHO emphasizes border surveillance, cross-border cooperation, and strengthened health preparedness to curb spread; emphasizes isolation, contact tracing, lab confirmation, and safe care.

article.articleHeadline: Yum! Brands stock rises despite Taco Bell outbreak
article.articleSummary: Cyclospora outbreak linked to shredded iceberg lettuce at Taco Bell across nine states caused 1,947 illnesses and 98 hospitalizations (no deaths) per CDC; FDA traced contamination to Taylor Farms de Mexico, with Taco Bell pulling the lettuce nationwide by July 17. Despite the scare, Yum! Brands stock rose 3% on July 30 after Q2 results that captured pre-outbreak strength. Q2 ended June 30: adjusted earnings $1.62 per share, vs $1.58 expected; revenue $2.17 billion, up 12% and near $2.2B. Management said the outbreak caused a meaningful but temporary sales decline; by July 27 Taco Bell location sales were down 2% in Q3-to-date, vs Q2 growth of 7%. Third-quarter margins expected 19–21% vs 26.2% in Q2. The industry framing as a farm-level problem limited fallout; Yum announced Pizza Hut sale for $2.7B, with LongRange Capital buying international units and Yum China acquiring the mainland piece, leaving KFC and Taco Bell core.

article.articleSummary: China’s COVID-19 outbreak shows a rising infection rate, with the Chinese CDC reporting that for July 20–26 the positivity rate exceeded 20% for the first time, meaning about one in five tests were positive. The August 2, 2026 report provides the weekly positivity data but does not offer absolute case counts or deaths. This data point signals a renewed transmission trajectory in China and implications for testing strategies and public health measures, highlighting ongoing outbreak activity across the country.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola | Naapurimaiden ebolatilanteet erkanivat: Uganda julisti epidemiansa päättyneen, Kongossa kriisi pahenee
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | Ebola situations in neighboring countries diverged: Uganda declared its outbreak over, Congo's crisis worsens.
article.articleSummary: Uganda declared its Ebola outbreak over after 42 days without a local case; the last locally linked patient was discharged on June 16, and the country is considered free following two incubation periods per WHO. Uganda reported 20 confirmed Ebola cases. Across the border in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the outbreak remains the fastest-spreading on record, with WHO data of more than 3,600 cases and over 1,600 deaths. The Congo outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy, and has been designated a public health emergency of international concern. The first Ugandan cases were Congolese who crossed into Uganda’s Ituri Province seeking care. Public health measures include border closures and suspended transport; aid delivery is hampered by mistrust and insecurity, and attacks on treatment centers. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids; contagiousness begins with symptoms; incubation up to three weeks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱｜近隣国のエボラ状況は分岐：ウガンダは流行終息を宣言、コンゴでは危機悪化

article.articleHeadline: Enhancing Infection Prevention Measures in Health Facilities to Curb Ebola Spread | South Africa Today
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province prompted a reinforced infection prevention and control (IPC) response in Bunia. At Bunia University Hospital, escalating fevers and deaths amid weak IPC exposed healthcare worker infections, including a staff physician who contracted Ebola and later recovered. WHO, with government partners, assessed facilities and implemented mandatory entry screening, patient triage, isolation of suspected cases, and proper PPE use for all healthcare workers, including cleaners and mortuary staff. Non-medical staff received training, decontamination kits were distributed, and exposure durations were reduced. To date, WHO IPC teams have supported over 900 health facilities and trained more than 1,000 health workers. In Kigonze, a displacement site with crowded conditions, risks were highlighted and addressed. Facilities now feature handwashing stations and mandatory temperature checks, with IPC practices embedded across healthcare settings to curb further transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Temporal passa em MS, mas água contaminada mantém risco de doenças
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The storm passes through MS, but contaminated water continues to pose a risk of disease.
article.articleSummary: Following heavy rains in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, flooding raised water- and waste-related disease risks. The city recorded 102.4 mm of rain in 24 hours—the nation's highest—before waters receded. Health experts warn that floodwater, mud and debris can transmit leptospirosis, cholera, hepatitis and typhoid fever, and that post- flood conditions favor Aedes aegypti breeding, with Campo Grande reporting 1,354 dengue and 36 chikungunya cases so far this year. Protective guidance includes wearing boots, gloves and long clothing during cleanup, inspecting footwear and clothing, removing debris, eliminating standing water, and storing potable water in closed containers; any foods touched by floodwater should be discarded. Do not attempt to capture venomous wildlife; seek medical care for bites or stings. Prompt medical evaluation is advised for anyone with fever, body pains, diarrhea or vomiting after floodwater exposure, or for wounds.

article.articleHeadline: Jahanabad News: जहानाबाद में एक लाख अठारह हजार की हुई टीबी की स्क्रीनिंग

article.articleSummary: As of August 2, 2026, Jehanabad district in Bihar, India completed TB screening of 118,804 residents under a TB elimination drive. The district administration notes the TB-free mission aims to identify and treat TB cases while ensuring patients receive proper nutrition and support to become fully healthy. In collaboration with Alkem Laboratories, all identified TB patients in the district will receive a TB Food and Nutrition Kit for six months to meet nutritional needs during treatment and bolster cure rates. The initiative underscores nutrition support as a critical component of TB care and aims to sustain treatment adherence and outcomes over the coming months.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak 'intensifying'
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo intensifies: as of 30 July 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality rate 44%). Declared May 15; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. The outbreak center is Ituri province in northeastern DRC, near borders with South Sudan and Uganda, with spread to four other provinces including North Kivu and South Kivu, where large areas are controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 group. WHO warns sustained transmission and rising cases and deaths amid insecurity, population displacement, mobility, and cross-border movements that complicate response and risk further spread. The WHO-described 'most promising' vaccine will be developed by Hilleman Laboratories (Singapore-based); previously, Oxford University started a clinical trial of a separate Bundibugyo vaccine, with the first volunteer dosed last week.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi bez kontrole: Hiljade zaraženih i više od 1.500 mrtvih u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading out of control: Thousands infected and more than 1,500 dead in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola caused by Bundibugyo strain spreads from Ituri’s Mongbvalu zone, DRC, to multiple provinces with spillovers to Uganda. As of July 30, 2026, WHO counts 3,626 cases and 1,589 deaths: 3,605/1,587 in DRC and 20/2 in Uganda. Case fatality about 44%; at least 651 recoveries in DRC and 18 in Uganda. Ituri accounts for 88% of cases and over 82% of deaths. Over 17,800 contacts are being followed; 151 health workers infected, 44 of whom died. Conflict, displacement, mobility, and attacks on health facilities hinder response. Uganda declared end to local transmission on July 28, 2026 after 42 days without new locally transmitted cases; last imported patient discharged July 16, 2026. WHO assesses very high risk in DRC, high in Uganda and neighbors; global risk remains low. Transmission is animal-to-human via blood and bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms fever, fatigue, myalgia, sore throat; severe disease with organ failure and hemorrhage possible.

article.articleSummary: COVID-19 positivity rate in Mainland China rose above 20% for July 20–26 (20.3%), marking the first time it exceeded 20% according to July 30 data from the China CDC. article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Becomes Fastest Growing On Record
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing one of the fastest-growing Ebola outbreaks caused by the Bundibugyo strain. As of Aug 2, 2026, more than 3,300 confirmed cases have been reported across five eastern provinces, with about 1,500 deaths. The outbreak was declared in May 2026, and there is currently no standard treatment for Bundibugyo. Response efforts are hampered by ongoing conflict, insecurity, and high population density in affected areas, complicating case finding, contact tracing, and vaccination campaigns. Public health authorities are scaling up vaccination and outbreak response measures while clinical vaccine trials began earlier this month to evaluate a vaccine against the strain, as authorities work to contain the spread.

article.articleHeadline: Број потврђених случајева оболелих од еболе у свету достигао 3.626
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases worldwide has reached 3,626.
article.articleSummary: Global Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Uganda, with one imported case in France. As of 30 July 2026, the World Health Organization reports 3,626 confirmed cases worldwide and 1,589 deaths. In the DRC, 3,605 cases and 1,587 deaths; Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths. The case-fatality rate is roughly 44%. Recoveries include at least 651 in the DRC and 18 in Uganda. The epidemic, first limited to the Mongbvalu zone in Ituri province, has expanded in two months to five provinces and 49 zones; Ituri accounts for about 88% of cases and over 82% of deaths. More than 17,800 contacts are being followed; 151 health workers infected, 44 killed. Conflict, displacement, mobility, and attacks on health facilities hinder response. Uganda declared the outbreak over on 28 July after 42 days without local transmission; WHO will monitor 42 more days.

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يخرج عن السيطرة في الكونغو الديمقراطية مع ارتفاع الإصابات والوفيات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Out of Control in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as Infections and Deaths Rise.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains out of control, with the WHO warning of continued spread as infections rise. In the past week: 567 new cases and 296 deaths; total laboratory-confirmed cases 3,605, with 1,587 deaths and 651 recoveries. This is the largest outbreak in DRC history and raises cross-border transmission risk to neighboring countries. The WHO calls for a major expansion of response activities. Contact tracing covers about 80% of contacts for three weeks; effective containment requires monitoring at least 95%. Ongoing conflict, mass displacement, and distrust between communities and health authorities hinder surveillance, vaccination, and rapid response. The DRC has had more than 10 Ebola outbreaks; the 2018–2020 outbreak had 3,317 confirmed cases and over 2,200 deaths, amid fighting in North Kivu and Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、コンゴ民主共和国で制御不能に陥る　感染者・死者数が急増
