article.articleHeadline: Zoonosis, de los animales al ser humano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zoonosis: From Animals to Humans
article.articleSummary: Thirteen hantavirus cases and three deaths occurred on the cruise MV Hondius; the World Health Organization declared the outbreak finished after the last exposed person completed quarantine and tested negative. Ebola remains a major concern: a Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, declared May 15, has caused 399 deaths and 1,333 confirmed cases, with spread to Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths). MSF notes overwhelmed treatment centers in Ituri and late patient presentation. Six Ebola strains are identified (Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Taï Forest, Reston, Bombali). Hantavirus Andes is the outbreak-linked strain; European/Asian hantaviruses can cause haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome, while American hantaviruses cause hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome with 20–40% fatality. Rabies causes about 59,000 deaths annually, mainly via dog bites; incubation typically 3–8 weeks, and post-exposure prophylaxis remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: 人獣共通感染症：動物からヒトへ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが399名死亡・1,333症例に達し、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し緊急性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は人獣共通感染症全般に関する教育的内容だが、実際に進行中のDRCエボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株、399名死亡、1,333症例確認、ウガンダへ拡大）に関する具体的かつ深刻な情報を含む。MSFは治療センターの逼迫と患者受診の遅れを報告しており、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ハンタウイルス（クルーズ船MV Hondius）は既に終息宣言済みのため本トリアージの主要対象外。

article.articleHeadline: ДО САДА ЗАРАЖЕНО 3.605 ЉУДИ, А УМРЛО ЧАК 1.587, један заражен У ФРАНЦУСКОЈ: Ебола наставља да се шири, упозорава СЗО:
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: So far, 3,605 people have been infected, and as many as 1,587 have died; one person infected in France: Ebola continues to spread, warns WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with one imported case in France, as of 2 August 2026. DRC reports 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths (case fatality ~44%), while Uganda has 20 cases and 2 deaths; recoveries total at least 651 in the DRC and 18 in Uganda. The outbreak began in the Mongbvalu zone of Ituri Province and has expanded over two months to five provinces and 49 zones; Ituri accounts for about 88% of cases and over 82% of deaths. More than 17,800 contacts are being followed; 151 health workers infected, 44 of whom died. Ongoing challenges include armed conflict, displacement, high population movement, and attacks on health facilities. Uganda declared an end to its outbreak on 28 July after 42 days with no local transmission; the last imported case was discharged 16 July, with a further 42-day monitoring period. Bundibugyo ebolavirus; incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, myalgia, headache, sore throat, potentially progressing to organ failure and hemorrhage, underscoring continued risk for neighboring regions and imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: これまでに3,605人が感染、1,587人が死亡、フランスでも1人感染確認：エボラは拡大を続けているとWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行(3,605例、死亡1,587例)が継続し、フランスへの越境感染も発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWHOにより流行終息宣言済み(7月28日)、フランスは輸入症例1件のみで対象国リストに含まれず。DRCが引き続き主要な発生地域。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak largest on record, warns WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is the largest on record, with 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths as of 30 July 2026, yielding a crude case fatality ratio of 44%. The World Health Organization warns that transmission continues to accelerate, with expanding geographic reach and high mortality. In the most recent complete reporting week, 567 cases and 296 deaths were recorded, underscoring the fast pace of spread. Ongoing insecurity, population displacement, mobility, and cross-border movements are complicating response operations and surveillance. The scale of the outbreak and evolving transmission present sustained containment challenges, demanding intensified public health measures, enhanced coordination across districts and neighboring countries, and robust laboratory confirmation and patient management. Date: 2 August 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、過去最大規模とWHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率44%、症例数・死亡数ともに過去最大規模で拡大が加速しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確に認められるため。
triage.notes: WHOが公式に過去最大規模と警告しており、国境を越えた人の移動も指摘されているため、近隣国への波及リスクを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola outbreak started at least in January, report shows
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak, now the world's second-largest on record, has reached 3,532 cases, with transmission concentrated in eastern Ituri province near the mining town of Mongbwalu. A Science-based report indicates the outbreak began at least in January, possibly earlier, tracing an initial transmission chain from a 50-year-old woman (case 'A') who died January 25 after vomiting blood; her mother died six days later, and her husband fell ill but recovered. Researchers interviewed 97 people and reviewed communications to map early spread, identifying more than 500 suspected cases between mid‑January and May 15, when the outbreak was announced. The virus is the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Only West Africa's 2014‑16 outbreak (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) was larger, with 28,616 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは少なくとも1月に始まっていたことが報告書で判明
triage.triage_reason: 史上2番目の規模となる大規模エボラアウトブレイク(3,532症例)であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法のないブンディブギョ株であることから、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれているが、これらは過去の2014-16年西アフリカアウトブレイクとの比較のために言及されているのみで、現在の発生国はDRCのみ。ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株である点、及び史上2番目の規模である点は特筆すべき重大要素。

article.articleHeadline: CHSO urges caution amid gastro rise
article.articleSummary: Cholera remains low in Baguio, with 2 cases reported from June–July 2026 and 1 in the same period 2025; the cumulative total is five cases for both years, with no deaths this year from acute bloody diarrhea, cholera, rotavirus or typhoid fever. Rotavirus infections rose to 84 cases in June–July 2026, up from 62 in the prior year; January–July cumulative reached 331 vs 160 (107% increase). Typhoid fever climbed to 52 cases in June–July 2026, up from 35; January–July total 125 vs 73 in 2025 (71% rise). The CHSO notes ongoing environmental health monitoring and water quality testing of all drinking sources in Baguio, with issues addressed. Preventive guidance urges boiling drinking water at least three minutes when source safety is uncertain, drinking only safe water, and thorough handwashing and proper food handling. Residents with acute gastroenteritis symptoms—diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain—should seek care at their nearest district health center.

triage.headline_ja: CHSO、胃腸炎増加に伴い注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コレラは低水準で死亡例もないが、ロタウイルスと腸チフスの症例数が前年比で大幅増加しており、感染症拡大の兆候として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局（CHSO）が既に水質検査・予防啓発を実施中であり、局地的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。ロタウイルス・腸チフスの増加傾向は続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: La República Democrática del Congo eleva a 1.621 la cifra de muertos y a 3.674 los casos confirmados de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the death toll to 1,621 and the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 3,674.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 1,621 Ebola deaths and 3,674 confirmed cases as of July 31, in an outbreak that began May 15 in Ituri and spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Case fatality 44.1%. About 760 patients are in isolation or hospital, and 666 have recovered; contact tracing stands at 78%. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest by cases globally, the largest in-country on record, though still below the West Africa 2014–2016 outbreak (about 11,000 deaths and 28,000 cases). The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; WHO notes high regional risk and low global risk. Five provinces are affected: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 42 days without new infections; 20 cases in Uganda, 15 imported from the DRC, and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の死者数を1,621人、確定症例数を3,674人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模エボラ流行（致死率44.1%、5州に拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染）が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダは越境流入例であり主題はDRC国内流行のため対象国リストにないUgandaは含めず。ワクチン・特異的治療法未承認のBundibugyo株であり、WHOは地域リスク高・世界リスク低と評価。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго продолжува да се шири, потврдени над 3.600 случаи и речиси 1.600 починати
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with over 3,600 confirmed cases and nearly 1,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo variant Ebola outbreak in the DRC continues, with 3,626 confirmed cases and 1,589 deaths worldwide as of July 30. In the DRC: 3,605 cases; Uganda: 20; France: 1 imported case. Case fatality about 44%. Recovered include 651 in the DRC and 18 in Uganda. The outbreak has spread from Ituri's Mongbvalu area to multiple provinces; Ituri accounts for 88% of cases and over 82% of deaths. Over 17,800 contacts are under follow-up; 151 health workers infected, 44 died. Armed conflict, displacement, and attacks on health facilities hinder control. Uganda declared the outbreak over on July 28; no local cases in 42 days; last imported case discharged July 16; WHO will monitor 42 more days. Risk: very high in the DRC, high in Uganda and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が拡大継続、確定症例3,600人超・死者約1,600人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、致死率約44%、国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダ・フランスへの越境例）が確認されているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは42日間新規症例なくWHOが7月28日に流行終息を宣言済み。フランスは輸入症例1例のみで対象国外。対象国リストにウガンダ・フランスが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。武力紛争・住民避難・医療施設への攻撃が対応を妨げている点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases rise in Cebu City
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Cebu City, Philippines, recorded 1,228 cases and 10 deaths from Jan 1 to July 18, 2026, a 12.35% rise from 1,093 cases. The case fatality rate is 0.81% as Cebu City remains under DOH endemic classification, not at alert or epidemic thresholds. Officials attribute the increase to persistent rains that clog drainage and create stagnant water, with garbage hindering water flow and boosting Aedes breeding. Ages range from 2 months to 96 years, median 12; children 1–10 years account for about 498 cases (40.55%), while males total 661 (53.83%). From July 12–18, 17 new cases followed a Morbidity Week 26 peak of 78. Highest barangays by cases include Guadalupe and Basak San Nicolas. Mortality spread across districts; hospitals include Cebu City Medical Center (5) and Vicente Sotto Memorial Medical Center (1) among others. City promotes the DOH 5S dengue prevention strategy and school-based 'Search and Destroy' measures.

triage.headline_ja: セブ市でデング熱症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: セブ市のデング熱は前年より増加しているが、DOHはエンデミック分類のまま警戒・流行閾値には達しておらず、国際的な異常事態とは言えないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: デング熱はセブ市でエンデミックとして継続監視されている季節性増加であり、DOHは警戒・流行レベルには達していないと明言。降雨とゴミによる蚊の繁殖環境が要因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Saudi Arabia bans travellers from 3 African countries over fresh Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in parts of Africa led Saudi Arabia to suspend entry for travellers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, and to ban entry visas for anyone who had stayed in those countries within the prior 21 days. Saudi citizens are also prohibited from traveling to those three states. Four additional African countries—Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania and the Republic of the Congo—will face enhanced health screening, disease surveillance and preventive checks at ports of entry. The Saudi Public Health Authority (Weqaya) says no confirmed Ebola cases have been recorded in the Kingdom since 2019 and that surveillance remains active, with measures to be updated as the outbreak evolves. France has confirmed a new Ebola case linked to the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo."

triage.headline_ja: サウジアラビア、新たなエボラ出血熱流行を受けアフリカ3か国からの渡航者を禁止
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続するエボラ出血熱の流行に対し、サウジアラビアが渡航禁止措置を発動し、フランスでも関連症例が確認されるなど、国際的拡大と渡航制限の両方が確認されるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行を主題とし、サウジアラビアの渡航制限措置とフランスでの関連症例確認を報じている。スーダン・ルワンダ・ブルンジ・タンザニア・ウガンダ・フランス・サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: هل أخفى فاوتشي ما كان يعرفه؟.. مقال يثير تساؤلات جديدة حول جائحة كورونا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did Fauci Hide What He Knew? An Article Raises New Questions About the Coronavirus Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Anthony Fauci’s invocation of the Fifth Amendment during a Senate COVID-19 origins hearing rekindles questions about the pandemic response. Michael Goodwin argues the episode exposes gaps between Fauci’s public statements and private memos, including awareness of U.S. funding for gain‑of‑function research at the Wuhan Institute of Virology and conversations suggesting a lab‑leak hypothesis was plausible. The piece notes an 11‑scientist call that favored lab escape and Fauci’s public dismissal of the theory as conspiracy, highlighting a fundamental public/private contradiction. It cites a January 2020 memo describing the Wuhan market as not the source but a amplifier, and a March 15, 2020 ‘BIG DAY’ memo about persuading NYC to close schools, later denied by Fauci. The article critiques media bias, media figures’ closeness to Fauci, and states there is no final verdict on origin, despite a Biden pardon.

triage.headline_ja: ファウチ氏は知っていたことを隠したのか？ ある記事がコロナウイルス・パンデミックについて新たな疑問を提起
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はCOVID-19起源を巡る米上院公聴会とファウチ氏の証言に関する政治的・歴史的検証記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年のCOVID-19起源調査・ファウチ氏の証言に関する政治的検証であり、現行の感染症発生イベントではない。武漢・中国は起源論争の文脈で言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak death toll tops 1,600
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to accelerate, with 34 additional confirmed deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the toll to 1,621 since the outbreak began about 2.5 months ago (as of 2026-08-02). Sixty-nine additional confirmed cases were reported in the same period, for a total of 3,674 confirmed cases. Affected health zones total 49 across five provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele and Tshopo. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 87.9% of cumulative cases and 76.8% of new daily cases. The current outbreak is the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record, surpassing the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak, which took roughly eight months to reach 1,000 deaths; this outbreak reached that milestone in just over two months.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、死者数が1,600人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが史上最速の拡大ペースを示し、5州49保健地区に拡大、死者1,600人超・症例3,600人超と深刻かつ異常事態であり、国際的拡大リスクも高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 史上最速のエボラ流行とされ、致死率・拡大速度ともに極めて高い。北Kivuも影響地域とされているが発生地域リストには明示されていないため注記。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : plus de 1600 décès enregistrés en RDC (Rapport)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 1,600 deaths recorded in the DRC (Report)
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease epidemiological report published July 31, 2026, covers five provinces and 48 health zones in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, and Tshopo are affected; South Kivu’s Miti-Murhesa is the only zone active with 65 days without a new confirmed case, while Wanie-Rukula is signaled but not yet integrated in totals. Cumulative figures: 3,674 confirmed cases; 760 patients in isolation or hospitalized; 666 recoveries; 1,621 deaths (case fatality rate 44.1%); contact follow-up rate 78%. Lab and surveillance capacities remain operational with many alerts investigated and samples analyzed, though some health facilities face pressure. No new health zone was affected in the last 24 hours, allowing resources to focus on existing foci.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:コンゴ民主共和国で1,600人以上の死者を記録(報告)
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCの5州48保健地域に拡大し、致死率44.1%、累計死者1,621人と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準の複数該当かつ国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 既知の大規模エボラアウトブレイクの継続報告。複数州にまたがり、致死率が高く、国際支援の必要性が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Are we ignoring a brewing epidemic?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo beginning in late May 2026 is driven by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), the first major outbreak of this type with no available treatment or vaccine. In under two months, confirmed cases exceed 2,500 and deaths surpass 1,000. This outbreak differs from the 2014 Zaire-strain crisis, which had vaccines and treatments, highlighting gaps in public health readiness. About 80% of cases have no known contacts, indicating widespread, undetected community transmission and weak contact tracing. Ebola spreads through direct contact with body fluids; it is not airborne, though burial practices have aided spread in some communities. Imported cases have appeared in Europe and the USA. Despite more than $3 billion invested globally for detection and response (2014–2019), the article warns of inadequate infrastructure, calls for accountability and transparency, and urges decisive action to prevent broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちは拡大しつつある流行を無視しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)によるDRCでの大規模流行で症例2500人超・死者1000人超、治療薬・ワクチンなし、欧米への輸出例もあり国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 米国は輸入症例のみのため対象国リストに含まれず、verified_locationsから除外。BDBV株は治療・ワクチンが未確立で重症度・拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Une responsable plaide pour un renforcement de la surveillance afin de détecter les cas suspects d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: A female official pleads for strengthened surveillance to detect suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threats in Angola's Uíge province underscore strengthened frontline surveillance to detect suspected cases amid neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak declared May 15, 2026. Ebola causes high fever and hemorrhagic symptoms; transmission via direct contact with fluids from infected humans or animals. RDC has surpassed 3,075 laboratory-confirmed cases and 1,354 deaths as of the report. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment reported. Angolan provincial health director Kavenaweteko Adelaide urged continuous epidemiological surveillance, emergency plans, rapid response teams, adequate equipment and laboratory capacity, clear communication, and cross-sector coordination. In outbreaks, immediate notification, epidemiological investigation, secure isolation, contact tracing, appropriate clinical care, health worker protection, and transparent population communication are essential. Strict infection prevention and control in health facilities (PPE, hand hygiene, waste management, disinfection) are emphasized to prevent spread and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ:女性責任者がエボラ疑い症例検出のための監視強化を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 隣国DRCで発生中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは3,075例の確定症例・1,354人の死亡を記録しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルRRAへ進むべき事案である。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラ・ウイジェ州における監視強化の呼びかけを主題としているが、実際のエボラ出血熱の発生・症例・死亡はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）の第17次アウトブレイクによるものであり、アンゴラでは確定症例の報告はない。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。ワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点も深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo: 1 621 muertos por ébola en el brote más acelerado de la historia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 1,621 deaths from Ebola in the fastest outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: As of 2 August 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 1,621 Ebola deaths and 3,674 confirmed cases since the outbreak began in May last year, per the Ministry of Communication. The case fatality ratio is 44.1%, with 760 people still in isolation or hospitalization and 666 recovered. The outbreak spans five provinces: Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, and Tshopo. It is the second-largest Ebola outbreak in DRC history by case counts and the fastest-growing on record, surpassing the 2018–2020 outbreak which caused 2,299 deaths. The strain is Bundibugyo, with a fatality rate typically 30–50%; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization assesses the risk of spread in sub-Saharan Africa as high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：史上最速で拡大するエボラ流行で死者1,621人
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速拡大・致死率44.1%の大規模エボラ流行が5州に及び、WHOがサブサハラアフリカでの拡大リスクを高いと評価しており、IHR基準の複数該当が明らか。
triage.notes: ワクチン未承認・特異的治療法なし、致死率30-50%のBundibugyo株による流行で、史上2番目の規模かつ史上最速の拡大速度。WHOはサブサハラアフリカ全域への拡大リスクを高いと評価しており、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Délestages, prisons, Ebola...Les 5 infos du week-end
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Power outages, prisons, Ebola... The 5 weekend news items.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has grown to become the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the country. By 30 July 2026, 3,605 confirmed cases and 1,587 deaths have been reported across five provinces. Transmission remains ongoing; insecurity and limited access complicate containment, and there is no approved vaccine for this strain. The World Health Organization urges a strengthened response to interrupt transmission, improve surveillance, case management, and risk communication. The outbreak underscores persistent public health challenges in the DRC, including strained health infrastructure and ongoing instability that hinder rapid outbreak suppression. There is no approved vaccine for this Bundibugyo strain, compounding response challenges.

triage.headline_ja: 停電、刑務所、エボラ…週末の5つのニュース
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが継続しており、症例3,605例・死亡1,587例、承認ワクチンなしという重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 史上最大規模のブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイク。致死率約44%、承認ワクチンなし、治安不安と医療インフラの脆弱性が対応を困難にしている。WHOが対応強化を要請しており、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: هل أخفى فاوتشي ما كان يعرفه؟.. مقال يثير تساؤلات جديدة حول جائحة كورونا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Did Fauci hide what he knew? .. An article raises new questions about the COVID-19 pandemic.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 origin and crisis-management are under scrutiny after a New York Post piece by Michael Goodwin questions Dr. Anthony Fauci's knowledge and actions. The article says Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment and declined to answer Senate questions, arguing this reveals media oversight failures rather than truth being hidden. Citing memos allegedly on government devices, it claims a gap between Fauci's public statements and private discussions about the virus's origins. It asserts he was aware of scientific debates on a Wuhan Institute of Virology lab-leak hypothesis and of U.S. funding for gain-of-function research, while publicly dismissing the theory as conspiracy. A January 2020 note reportedly said the Wuhan market was not the source but amplified spread; a March 15 memo allegedly records a “BIG DAY!” after persuading local officials to close schools, contrasting with later denials of involvement. The piece argues media and officials lacked accountability; the origin debate remains unsettled.

triage.headline_ja: ファウチ氏は知っていたことを隠したのか？…新型コロナウイルスのパンデミックについて新たな疑問を投げかける記事
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19起源やファウチ氏の対応を巡る政治的・歴史的検証記事であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上のシグナルや新規発生情報ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年のCOVID-19起源・対応を巡る過去の政治的論争を扱う内容であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威に関する情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄母女越南返台染登革熱　就醫「未主動告知旅遊史」遭罰1萬元 | LIFE生活網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung mother and daughter who returned from Vietnam contracted dengue fever; upon seeking medical care, they were fined NT$10,000 for not proactively disclosing travel history | LIFE Lifestyle Network
article.articleSummary: Two imported dengue fever cases were confirmed in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, involving a 37-year-old Vietnamese immigrant and her 13-year-old daughter living in Dong’anli, Jiaxian District. They had visited Vietnam from July 2–24 and returned with fever and muscle pains; both tested positive for dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2)—the mother on July 31 and the daughter by August 1 after contact tracing. Both are hospitalized with mosquito precautions; local health teams conducted home area mosquito source checks, emergency spraying, and environmental remediation to curb transmission. The Kaohsiung City Health Bureau emphasized legal obligations to cooperate with epidemiological investigations and to disclose travel history; the mother was fined NT$10,000 for failing to report travel. A dengue surveillance program offers rapid testing for returnees from Southeast Asian countries within 14 days of return, with a 500 NT voucher for those who complete testing.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄の母娘がベトナムから帰国後にデング熱に感染、受診時に旅行歴を申告せず1万台湾ドルの罰金
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）における輸入症例2件の個別報告であり、対象国での感染拡大や異常な公衆衛生事象は確認されない。
triage.notes: 台湾（Kaohsiung）はデング熱輸入症例2例の診断・対応地であるが対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナムは患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、記事の主題はベトナムでの発生状況ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 母女越南回台灣發燒⋯確診登革熱！就醫「隱瞞1事」　高雄衛生局怒罰1萬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mother and daughter return from Vietnam to Taiwan with fever… diagnosed with dengue fever! They hid one detail when seeking medical care, Kaohsiung City Health Bureau fines NT$10,000.
article.articleSummary: On 2 August 2026, Kaohsiung City Health Bureau reported two new imported dengue fever type-2 cases, bringing Taiwan’s total to 15 imported cases. The patients are a 37-year-old Vietnamese immigrant and her 13-year-old daughter, residents of Kaohsiung City. They traveled to Vietnam from July 2–24; after returning they developed fever, dizziness, and muscle pain, with PCR confirming dengue virus type 2. The mother and daughter initially failed to disclose travel history, resulting in a NT$10,000 fine under the Infectious Diseases Control Act. Both are hospitalized under mosquito isolation; authorities conducted home inspections, emergency spraying, and environmental cleanup. The bureau urges TOCC disclosure during care seeking; travelers returning from Southeast Asia with fever or compatible symptoms within 14 days should seek rapid testing, while asymptomatic individuals may visit district health offices for testing and can obtain a NT$500 voucher. Four steps: inspect, drain, clean, scrub.

triage.headline_ja: 母娘がベトナムから台湾帰国後に発熱…デング熱確診！受診時に「渡航歴を隠蔽」高雄市衛生局が1万元の罰金
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入例（ベトナム渡航歴あり）のデング熱2例で、地域内二次感染の報告はなく、通常の検疫・行政対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（高雄市）における輸入例の行政対応（渡航歴隠蔽への罰金、防疫措置）であり、ベトナムでの流行状況自体を報じるものではないため、対象国リストの該当なしと判断した。台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 「100年に1度のパンデミック」言えぬ時代に　相次ぐ感染症は問う：朝日新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In an era when we can't say "a once-in-a-century pandemic," successive infectious diseases raise questions
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus Ebola hemorrhagic fever is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in May. As of July 30, the DRC has 3,605 confirmed infections and 1,587 deaths. The outbreak lacks approved vaccines, and control is hampered by weak health systems, shortages of clean water, masks, and PPE, and burial practices involving contact with the deceased that facilitate transmission via body fluids. Osaka University Professor Kenji Kutsuna stresses that current societal structures heighten risk and calls for strengthened infection-control measures, community engagement, and resource provision. He previously assisted Congo’s 2018 outbreak response, highlighting challenges in interrupting transmission through funerary rites and basic hygiene. The article urges intensified international and Japan-level action to address ongoing outbreaks and bolster preparedness for future threats.

triage.headline_ja: 「100年に1度のパンデミック」言えぬ時代に　相次ぐ感染症は問う：朝日新聞
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）流行によりWHOが5月にPHEICを宣言し、致死率も高く（3,605例中1,587死亡）、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として既にフルRRAの対象となる案件。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（およびウガンダ）でのエボラ出血熱流行と、日本を含む国際社会への警鐘を論じる論説記事。ウガンダおよび日本は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health News 3.8: Tips for healthy, energy-saving sleep with the air conditioner | What to do if you develop influenza A symptoms?
article.articleSummary: As of August 3, 2026, influenza A activity is rising in Vietnam, with increased pediatric hospitalizations in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and Da Nang. Circulating strains include A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and influenza B, contributing to a complex seasonal pattern and elevating the risk of a winter surge. WHO notes that influenza viruses survive longer in cold environments, accelerating transmission. Guidance on actions when influenza A symptoms appear is included, though no specific treatments are detailed beyond general advice. The article also provides health tips for hot weather, recommending against very low air-conditioning settings and suggesting bedroom temperatures of about 25–27°C to support sleep health and conserve energy.

article.articleHeadline: Lebbra, i casi aumentano in Florida: cosa cambia per l'Italia e perché gli esperti invitano a non abbassare la guardia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leprosy, cases are rising in Florida: what this means for Italy and why experts are urging not to lower your guard.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-08-02, Florida reports 36 leprosy cases, renewing attention to a disease that remains global, curable. Leprosy (Hansen’s disease) in Florida highlights a suspected reservoir in the nine-banded armadillo, with soil exposure and occupations like gardening as possible routes; casual contact with armadillos or soil does not automatically transmit the disease. The WHO notes leprosy was never eradicated; in 2000 it was declared eliminated as a public health problem (less than 1 per 10,000). Roughly 170,000 cases occur worldwide, led by India, with Brazil and Indonesia as major hotspots; other high-burden countries include Bangladesh, Madagascar, Nepal, Nigeria, and South Sudan. Europe sees mostly imported cases. OMS strategies include contact tracing with rifampicin preventive therapy, Leprosy Elimination Framework for mapping, and free multidrug therapy for 6–12 months, with contagiousness reduced after initial doses. Incubation can reach 3–5 years; early signs are hypopigmented patches with sensory loss. Italy’s risk remains extremely low.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病、フロリダで症例増加：イタリアにとっての意味と専門家が警戒緩めるなと呼びかける理由
triage.triage_reason: フロリダ（米国）でのハンセン病症例増加に関する記事であり、対象国における新規発生事例ではない。疾患自体は既知・治療可能で公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はフロリダ（米国）での症例増加が主題であり、対象国リストにある国（インド・ブラジル・インドネシア等）は世界的な高負担国として一般統計として言及されているのみで、具体的な発生事象の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國爆史上最大伊波拉疫情，累計確診3674例、死亡1621人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the largest Ebola outbreak in history, with a cumulative total of 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is at a historic scale. As of July 31, 2026, cumulative confirmed cases are 3,674 with 1,621 deaths, a case-fatality rate around 44.1%. The World Health Organization says this is the largest Ebola outbreak on record in the DRC. Transmission occurs mainly through contact with infected body fluids and contaminated objects. Control measures include rapid diagnostics, patient isolation, contact tracing, vaccination campaigns, and safe burial practices. If cases rise further, local healthcare capacity could be overwhelmed and cross-border movement, air travel, mining operations, and regional supply chains may be disrupted. The DRC is a key cobalt and copper supplier; authorities warn of potential mining-region impacts if outbreaks reach transport hubs or health facilities. Monitoring spillover to neighbors and timely delivery of vaccines and medical supplies remains critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、史上最大のエボラ出血熱流行を報告、累計確定症例3,674例、死亡1,621人
triage.triage_reason: WHOが史上最大規模と認定した大規模エボラ流行であり、致死率約44%、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易への影響リスクも指摘されており、IHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOにより史上最大規模と発表されたDRCのエボラ流行。致死率約44.1%と高く、鉱業地帯や国境地域への波及、医療体制の逼迫、渡航・輸送・サプライチェーンへの影響が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: 疫情捲土重來？中國新冠病毒感染率「升破20%」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the outbreak making a comeback? China's COVID-19 infection rate surpasses 20%.
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 situation is intensifying again, according to the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention. In the week of July 20–26, 2026, the national COVID-19 test positivity rate rose above 20% for the first time in weeks, up 4 percentage points from the prior week. The highest positivity is observed in children aged 0–4, adults 15–59, and seniors 60+, with southern provinces reporting markedly higher rates than northern areas. The China CDC characterizes the rise as a cyclical fluctuation, similar in magnitude to the past two years, with no change in disease severity and no detection of a new variant of concern. Separately, Taiwan reports rising COVID-19 activity: 10,605 outpatient and emergency department visits in the week of July 19–25, 2026 (up 117.4% from the previous week), including 42 new locally severe cases and 2 locally recorded deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 疫情捲土重来？中国の新型コロナウイルス感染率が20%を突破
triage.triage_reason: 陽性率上昇や台湾での重症・死亡例増加が見られるが、中国CDCは季節的変動で重症度変化・新変異株なしと評価しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに明確な該当は少ない。今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。中国CDCは季節的変動と説明しているが、陽性率の急上昇と台湾での重症・死亡例増加は今後の動向を注視すべき指標。

article.articleHeadline: 전남광주시 "해외 여행시 감염병 주의하세요" - 보도자료 | 기사 - 더팩트
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jeonnam-Gwangju City: "Be careful of infectious diseases when traveling abroad" - Press Release | Article - The Fact
article.articleSummary: Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City issued travel infection prevention guidance on 2026-08-03. Measles outbreaks remain global, with cases in the Philippines, Mongolia, Japan, the United States, and Mexico; travelers should have two MMR vaccine doses, and unvaccinated individuals born after 1968 must complete vaccination at least four weeks before departure. Summer raises risk of waterborne and foodborne illnesses causing diarrhea and dehydration; prevention emphasizes washing hands with soap for 30 seconds, cooking meat and seafood thoroughly, and boiling drinking water. In Korea, the Japanese encephalitis vector mosquito (Culex tritaeniorhynchus) increased, triggering a nationwide JE alert on June 17. Dengue, chikungunya, and Zika remain a concern in Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Malaysia; symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, and joint pain, sometimes rash. Outdoors, wear light-colored long clothing and reapply mosquito repellent every 3–4 hours. Before travel, check KDCA advisories; after travel, seek care within two weeks if fever, rash, or diarrhea occurs and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 全南光州市「海外旅行時は感染症にご注意ください」- 報道資料
triage.triage_reason: 自治体による一般的な海外渡航感染症注意喚起の広報記事であり、新規または異常な発生事象の報告ではないため、シグナルとして扱う根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の季節性・地域流行病（麻疹、日本脳炎、デング熱等）に関する一般的な渡航者向け注意喚起であり、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。フィリピン、ベトナム、タイ、インドネシアなどが言及されているが、いずれも既存の一般的流行状況への言及に留まり、対象国での新規イベントとしての特定性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 【兩岸掃描】山東青島橡膠品倉庫起火爆炸 火勢兇猛 | 北戴河 | 訪民 | 大陸新冠疫情

article.articleSummary: Qingdao, Shandong: A warehouse of Qingdao Xiangyu Express Supply Chain Co., Ltd. in Huangdao district caught fire and exploded on August 2 around 5 p.m., with intense flames and thick black smoke. Firefighting is ongoing; officials report no casualties, though the actual situation remains unclear amid claims of disaster concealment. Burning rubber products can emit carbon monoxide, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, and toxic dioxins, raising respiratory and environmental health concerns. Beidaihe: While top leaders meet there, petitioners attempted to file grievances; many were intercepted, with Shanghai retiree Gu Guopeng among those detained after a July visit that began on July 21–24. COVID-19 outbreak in Mainland China: national positivity rate exceeded 20% for July 20–26, per China CDC data; NB.1.8.1 lineage remains dominant; outpatient/ED positivity climbed from 9.6% to 20.3% in three weeks, with true figures likely underreported.

triage.headline_ja: 【両岸スキャン】山東省青島市のゴム製品倉庫で火災爆発、猛烈な火勢｜北戴河｜陳情者｜中国本土の新型コロナウイルス感染状況

triage.notes: 記事の主題は倉庫火災・陳情者拘束であり、COVID-19情報は付随的な報道。中国CDCデータに基づく陽性率上昇（20%超）とNB.1.8.1系統の優勢が言及されているが、実態は過小報告の可能性も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 生死有定数 瘟疫根据人间善恶安排(图) - 探秘寻真 -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Life and Death Are Predetermined; Plagues Are Arranged According to Humanity's Good and Evil (Photo) - Explore Mysteries, Seek Truth -
article.articleSummary: Plagues are presented as preordained by heaven, arranged by humanity's virtue and vice. The article compiles Chinese mythic and historical tales where epidemics signal moral order. In Jing County, Hubei, an old, foul-smelling, blind woman visits doors; families she blessed later die of plague. A Ming tale links hundreds of children in colored garments and banners reading 'The world is in chaos' to outbreaks. In early Qing, central Yunnan's war aftermath is followed by a severe epidemic with fever, nodules, and delirium, leaving villages overrun. Daoist Zhang Daoling’s Celestial Masters lineage appears; envoy Xu Qi then averts Guangdong outbreak by letting people celebrate the New Year early and offering to gods. Lu Wan drives away demons; a virtuous widow is spared; a humane man buries the dead and saves a baby. Virtue governs fate; moral reflection can avert disaster.

triage.headline_ja: 生死は定数あり、疫病は人間の善悪に応じて配される（写真）－探秘尋真－

triage.notes: 本記事は民間伝承・宗教的道徳譚を扱う文化・霊性系コンテンツであり、実際の疾病発生報告ではないため対象国の特定は不要。

article.articleHeadline: Dampak Debu Kapur di KBB: 378 Warga Padalarang dan Cipatat Suspek TBC, Ratusan Kena ISPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Impact of Lime Dust in West Bandung Regency: 378 Padalarang and Cipatat Residents Suspected TB, Hundreds Affected by Acute Respiratory Infections
article.articleSummary: Lime-dust exposure in Padalarang and Cipatat, West Bandung Regency (Bandung Barat), Indonesia, is linked to broad respiratory health concerns. During July 25–31, 2026, four puskesmas screened 2,974 visits; 2,870 participants (96.5%) joined the Free Health Check program. Chest X-ray of 1,772 residents identified 378 suspected TB, with 304 immediately undergoing the Rapid Molecular Test (TCM) to confirm TB. Separately, 267 residents were diagnosed with Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA) and 25 with suspected Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). Among risk factors, 549 are active smokers, suggesting smoking worsens lung conditions amid dust exposure. The findings underscore ongoing laboratory confirmation and clinical follow-up for suspected TB and other respiratory diseases, highlighting a public health response to pollution-driven pulmonary risks in Padalarang–Cipatat.

triage.headline_ja: 西バンドン県における石灰粉塵の影響：パダラランとチパタットの住民378人が結核疑い、数百人が急性呼吸器感染症に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 石灰粉塵曝露による健康診断プログラムの結果報告であり、新規アウトブレイクというより既存の環境曝露に伴う疾患スクリーニング結果。結核疑い例数は多いが確定診断前であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事案は結核の新規アウトブレイクではなく、石灰粉塵曝露による地域住民への健康診断プログラム（Free Health Check）の結果として、胸部X線でTB疑い例やISPA、COPD疑いが多数見つかったという報告。感染症の急速な拡大というより環境曝露による慢性疾患スクリーニングの色合いが強い。TCM検査結果など今後の確定診断の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Debu Kapur Ancam Kesehatan Warga KBB, Dinkes Temukan Lonjakan Kasus ISPA dan Suspek TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lime Dust Threatens the Health of KBB Residents; Health Office Finds a Surge in ARI Cases and Suspected TB
article.articleSummary: From 25–31 July 2026, Bandung Barat Health Office screened residents in Padalarang and Cipatat, finding health concerns linked to limestone dust exposure. Of 2,974 clinic visits across four puskesmas, 2,870 (96.5%) participated in the Free Health Check (CKG). Results: 378 people are suspected TB cases; 267 have Acute Respiratory Infection (ARIs) with indications of asthma/COPD; 25 show signs of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). Chest X-rays were performed on 1,772 participants (61.7%). Among TB suspects, 304 immediately underwent the Rapid Molecular Test (TCM) to confirm diagnoses and guide treatment. Smoking is a notable risk factor, with 549 active smokers among participants. Health officials emphasize environmental exposure to lime dust as a potential long-term hazard and urge comprehensive measures to address respiratory health in the affected Padalarang-Cipatat area.

triage.headline_ja: 石灰粉塵がKBB住民の健康を脅かす、保健局がARIおよび結核疑い症例の急増を発見
triage.triage_reason: 石灰石粉塵への環境曝露に起因する呼吸器疾患・結核疑い症例のスクリーニング結果であり、感染症の異常な流行や国際的拡大の懸念を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本件は石灰石採掘地域における粉塵曝露による慢性呼吸器疾患（結核疑い、ARI、COPD等）のスクリーニング結果報告であり、感染症のアウトブレイクではなく環境保健問題として扱うべき事案。地元保健局による通常の健康診断・対策の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 전남광주특별시, "휴가철 여행 감염병 예방수칙 준수
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jeollanam-Gwangju Special City, "Compliance with travel-related infectious disease prevention guidelines during vacation season."
article.articleSummary: Jeollanam-Gwangju Integrated Special City urges residents to follow travel-related infectious disease guidelines during peak summer season as overseas travel and outdoor activities rise. Measles vigilance is advised for travelers to the Philippines, Mongolia, and Japan, requiring verification of pre-travel vaccination. Summer heat and humidity can promote bacterial and viral growth, increasing the risk of water- and foodborne illnesses that cause diarrhea and vomiting. On June 17, a nationwide Japanese encephalitis alert was issued. Travelers to Vietnam, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Malaysia should be alert to infection risks. Emphasizing hand hygiene and proper cough etiquette, symptoms commonly include fever, headache, muscle and joint pain, with rash possible. Before departure, check the destination’s disease status on the KDCA site; upon return, seek guidance from a public health center if symptoms appear.

article.articleHeadline: Rising Tides, Surge In Cases: Fiji, Philippines Face Unprecedented HIV Epidemics Amid Global Funding Cuts | OneNews.PH
article.articleSummary: Fiji is experiencing the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic, with about 12,000 people living with HIV in a population under 1 million. In Fiji, one in 60 adults is HIV-positive; infections among women are rising, and roughly one child is born with HIV each week and one dies from HIV-related complications each month. In the Philippines, 4,633 new diagnoses and an estimated 288,000 living with HIV; daily cases average 51–57, with 15–34-year-olds about 80% of new infections. Both miss the 95-95-95 targets; global funding cuts threaten responses. Fiji receives support from Australia and New Zealand; the Philippines from the United States and local groups. Community-led approaches and regional lessons from Africa are urged to sustain momentum as of 3 August 2026.
